envVars.description: GitLab personal access token for local stdio use. A non-empty value overrides GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE. One of this token, GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE, GITLAB_JOB_TOKEN, GITLAB_AUTH_COOKIE_PATH, or GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true must be set. Create a token with the GitLab scopes the tools need, such as api or read_api.

envVars.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file that contains the personal access token. Read once at startup and trimmed. Ignored when GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN or --token is non-empty. A missing, unreadable, or empty file stops startup. Does not replace job token, OAuth, cookie, or remote authorization.

envVars.name: GITLAB_JOB_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional GitLab CI job token to use instead of a personal access token when running inside GitLab CI.

envVars.name: GITLAB_AUTH_COOKIE_PATH
envVars.description: Optional path to a GitLab authentication cookie file for cookie-based authentication.

envVars.name: GITLAB_USE_OAUTH
envVars.description: Set to true to start with GitLab OAuth instead of a personal access token, job token, or cookie file.

envVars.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: GitLab OAuth application ID. When GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true, set this or GITLAB_OAUTH_TOKEN_SCRIPT.

envVars.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_TOKEN_SCRIPT
envVars.description: Command that prints an OAuth access token. When GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true, set this or GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

envVars.name: GITLAB_API_URL
envVars.description: GitLab API base URL. Use https://gitlab.com/api/v4 for GitLab.com or your self-managed GitLab API URL.

envVars.name: GITLAB_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated list of GitLab project IDs that this server is allowed to access.

envVars.name: GITLAB_PERMISSION_MODE
envVars.description: Tool exposure. Allowed values are readonly, modify, and full. Unset uses full. readonly keeps read-only tools. modify blocks delete and teardown tools.

envVars.name: GITLAB_TOOLSETS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated list of toolsets to enable, such as projects, issues, merge_requests, pipelines, releases, users, groups, wiki, or search.

envVars.name: GITLAB_TOOLS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated list of individual tool names to add on top of enabled toolsets.

envVars.name: GITLAB_DENIED_TOOLS_REGEX
envVars.description: Optional regular expression used to hide matching tools from the server.

envVars.name: GITLAB_TOOL_POLICY_APPROVE
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool names that require explicit approval before execution.

envVars.name: GITLAB_TOOL_POLICY_HIDDEN
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool names to hide from tools/list.

envVars.name: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
envVars.description: Set to 0 only when you intentionally need to connect to a GitLab instance with invalid or self-signed TLS certificates.

envVars.name: GITLAB_CA_CERT_PATH
envVars.description: Optional path to a custom CA certificate file for self-managed GitLab instances.

envVars.name: GITLAB_MASKING_ENABLED
envVars.description: Set to true to mask text tool results and returned errors using built-in or configured rules.

envVars.name: GITLAB_MASKING_CONFIG
envVars.description: Optional path to a response-masking JSON configuration file.

envVars.name: GITLAB_MASKING_POLICY_FILE
envVars.description: Optional protected server-owned JSON file containing managed masking policies.

envVars.name: GITLAB_MASKING_WORKSPACE_DIR

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ALLOW_REQUEST_OVERRIDES
envVars.description: When set to true, allows configuration values to be overridden via request headers and query parameters.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Atlas API client ID for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Atlas API client secret for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ASSISTANT_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL for the MongoDB Assistant API.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ATLAS_TEMPORARY_DATABASE_USER_LIFETIME_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds that temporary database users created when connecting to MongoDB Atlas clusters will remain active before being automatically deleted.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Requires the client to support elicitation.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_SCOPE
envVars.description: Visibility scope for MongoDB connections created at runtime. With 'session' (the default), each MCP session only sees the connections it created (plus the shared 'preconfigured' one) and they are closed when the session ends — recommended when the HTTP transport is exposed to multiple clients without authentication. With 'global', connections are shared across all sessions and survive session rotation.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING
envVars.description: MongoDB connection string for direct database connections. Optional, if not set, you'll need to call the connect tool before interacting with MongoDB data.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DISABLE_SERVER_SIDE_JS
envVars.description: When set to true, disallows the use of server-side JavaScript operators (such as $where, $function, and $accumulator) in query filters and aggregation pipelines.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of tool names, operation types, and/or categories of tools that will be disabled.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DRY_RUN
envVars.description: When true, runs the server in dry mode: dumps configuration and enabled tools, then exits without starting the server.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ELICITATION_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds the user has to respond to an elicitation request (such as a tool confirmation prompt) before it fails.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds between export cleanup cycles that remove expired export files.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds after which an export is considered expired and eligible for cleanup.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORTS_PATH
envVars.description: Folder to store exported data files.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXTERNALLY_MANAGED_SESSIONS
envVars.description: When true, the HTTP transport allows requests with a session ID supplied externally through the 'mcp-session-id' header. When an external ID is supplied, the initialization request is optional.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HEALTH_CHECK_HOST
envVars.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerHost` instead. Host address to bind the healthCheck HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckPort` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HEALTH_CHECK_PORT
envVars.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerPort` instead. Port number for the healthCheck HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckHost` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_BODY_LIMIT
envVars.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request body in bytes (only used when transport is 'http'). This value is passed as the optional limit parameter to the Express.js json() middleware.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_HEADERS
envVars.description: Header that the HTTP server will validate when making requests (only used when transport is 'http').

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Host address to bind the HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http').

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Port number for the HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). Use 0 for a random port.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_RESPONSE_TYPE
envVars.description: The HTTP response type for tool responses: 'sse' for Server-Sent Events, 'json' for standard JSON responses.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Idle timeout for a client to disconnect (only applies to http transport).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_INDEX_CHECK
envVars.description: When set to true, enforces that query operations must use an index, rejecting queries that perform a collection scan.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_LOG_PATH
envVars.description: Folder to store logs.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_LOGGERS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of logger types.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_ACTIVE_CONNECTIONS
envVars.description: Maximum number of MongoDB connections a single scope (an MCP session by default, see connectionScope) can hold open. When exceeded, the scope's least-recently-used connection is closed and its connectionId revoked. The preconfigured connection does not count towards the limit.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_BYTES_PER_QUERY
envVars.description: The maximum size in bytes for results from a find or aggregate tool call. This serves as an upper bound for the responseBytesLimit parameter in those tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_DOCUMENTS_PER_QUERY
envVars.description: The maximum number of documents that can be returned by a find or aggregate tool call. For the find tool, the effective limit will be the smaller of this value and the tool's limit parameter.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_SESSIONS
envVars.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions the HTTP transport will hold in memory (only used when transport is 'http'). Each session holds a full server instance, transport, and timers, so choose a value based on your deployment's available memory; the default is a conservative safety net rather than a recommended production value.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_TIME_M_S
envVars.description: The maximum time in milliseconds that operations are allowed to run on the MongoDB server. When set, this value is passed as the maxTimeMS option to read operations such as find, aggregate, and count.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MCP_CLIENT_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Minimum severity level for log messages forwarded to the MCP client.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_FEATURES
envVars.description: Features to expose on the monitoring server (only used when transport is 'http' and monitoringServerHost/monitoringServerPort are set).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_HOST
envVars.description: Host address to bind the monitoring HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerPort` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_PORT
envVars.description: Port number for the monitoring HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerHost` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_NOTIFICATION_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Notification timeout for a client to be aware of disconnect (only applies to http transport).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_PREVIEW_FEATURES
envVars.description: Comma separated values of preview features that are enabled.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: When set to true, only allows read, connect, and metadata operation types, disabling create/update/delete operations.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_TELEMETRY
envVars.description: When set to disabled, disables telemetry collection.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Either 'stdio' or 'http'.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_VOYAGE_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for Voyage AI embeddings service (required for creating Atlas Local deployments with auto-embed vector search capabilities).

description: Read, write, search, and surgically edit Obsidian notes, tags, and frontmatter via MCP.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_API_KEY
envVars.description: Bearer token for the Obsidian Local REST API plugin (Settings → Community Plugins → Local REST API).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of the Obsidian Local REST API. Default: http://127.0.0.1:27123 (enable "Non-encrypted (HTTP) Server" in plugin settings). Use https://127.0.0.1:27124 for the always-on HTTPS port (self-signed cert; pair with OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL=false).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL
envVars.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate on the Obsidian endpoint. Default false because the plugin uses a self-signed cert.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS
envVars.description: Opt-in flag for the command-palette pair (obsidian_list_commands + obsidian_execute_command). Off by default — Obsidian commands are opaque and can be destructive.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for reads. Prefix-based with implicit recursion; case-insensitive; trailing slashes normalized. Unset = full vault. Write paths are implicitly readable. Example: 'public/,projects/'.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Unset = full vault, or the read scope when reads are restricted. Example: 'projects/,scratch/'.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Global read-only kill switch. When true, every write is denied regardless of OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, and the command-palette pair is suppressed (commands can mutate). Useful for shared or public-facing deployments.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_DELETE_ELICITATION
envVars.description: Opt-in delete confirmation. When true, obsidian_delete_note asks the user to confirm each delete through an elicitation round (the client must support elicitation), and HTTP startup requires a stateful session unless OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY=true disables the tool. Off by default — the delete runs on the first call, bounded by OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS and OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_OMNISEARCH_URL
envVars.description: Override URL for the Omnisearch plugin HTTP server. Unset derives from OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL host with port 51361. Required only if the Omnisearch plugin is not on the default port.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

name: shinpr/mcp-local-rag
description: Local document search: semantic search over PDF, DOCX, TXT and Markdown files with LanceDB vector storage and local embeddings.

envVars.name: BASE_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

envVars.name: BASE_DIRS
envVars.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

envVars.name: IGNORE_PATHS
envVars.description: JSON array of glob patterns for files to keep out of the index, each matched against the file's path relative to its root (e.g. '["plugs/**","**/*.draft.md"]').

envVars.name: DB_PATH
envVars.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

envVars.name: HF_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Hugging Face model download endpoint. Set this to a mirror URL when direct downloads are blocked (defaults to https://huggingface.co).

envVars.name: MODEL_NAME
envVars.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

envVars.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
envVars.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

envVars.name: STORE_IMAGES
envVars.description: Store supported PDF and DOCX images during ingestion and return them with matched chunks (defaults to false).

envVars.name: EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX
envVars.description: Embed each chunk together with its document title, which can help when passages don't restate the topic the title names (defaults to false). After changing it, use a new DB_PATH or delete the index and re-ingest.

envVars.name: EMBED_HEADING_PREFIX
envVars.description: Add section headings to chunk embeddings when they fit (defaults to false). Independent of EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX. Re-ingest documents after changing it.

envVars.name: RAG_DEVICE
envVars.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

envVars.name: RAG_DTYPE
envVars.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

envVars.name: RAG_RERANK_CMD
envVars.description: External reranker command template. Use {query} and {top} for query text and result count; unset disables reranking.

envVars.name: RAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time budget per rerank call in milliseconds (100-600000, defaults to 10000). On timeout the spawned command is killed and the pre-rerank ordering is returned.

envVars.name: SEARCH_API
envVars.description: SearchApi API key. Required only for SearchApi primary or fallback modes.

envVars.name: SURF_SEARCH_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Provider for search and search_parallel: browser, searchapi, or fallback. Defaults to browser.

envVars.name: SURF_SCHOLAR_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Provider for scholar_search: browser, searchapi, or fallback. Defaults to browser.

envVars.name: SURF_BROWSER_ENGINE
envVars.description: Browser engine: auto, native, or playwright. Auto uses one hidden native Chrome broker shared across local MCP sessions.

envVars.name: CHROME_PATH
envVars.description: Absolute path to the Chrome binary. Auto-detected on Windows/macOS/Linux when omitted.

envVars.name: SURF_PROFILE_ROOT
envVars.description: Directory for the warm Chrome profile. Defaults to ~/.google-surf-mcp.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH
envVars.description: Enable local project memory and hybrid retrieval. Defaults to true.

envVars.name: SURF_RETRIEVAL_MODE
envVars.description: Shared route for search and search_parallel: live or hybrid. Defaults to hybrid.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH_ROOT
envVars.description: Embedded SurrealDB data directory. Defaults to <profile>/research.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH_VECTOR_MODEL
envVars.description: Local model for HNSW retrieval and shared reranking. Defaults to Xenova/multilingual-e5-small; use off to disable.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH_VECTOR_LOW_MEMORY
envVars.description: Disable ONNX CPU memory arena and memory pattern. Defaults to true.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH_VECTOR_THREADS
envVars.description: ONNX intra-op thread count from 1 to 16. Defaults to 4.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH_REPO_AUTO
envVars.description: Sparse-index at most one eligible small GitHub repository per search call. Defaults to true.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH_REPO_AUTO_MAX_MB
envVars.description: Maximum searchable repository source-text size in MB. Assets are excluded. Defaults to 20.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH_REPO_AUTO_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Maximum repository source file count for automatic indexing. Defaults to 2000.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH_BROKER_IDLE_MS
envVars.description: Shared research broker idle lifetime in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH_READ_CONCURRENCY
envVars.description: Maximum concurrent research broker reads. Defaults to 4.

envVars.name: SURF_RESEARCH_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Timeout per embedded SurrealDB query in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000; timed-out retrieval lanes are reported as partial.

envVars.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional token that raises GitHub API limits for repository inspection.

envVars.name: SURF_LOCALE
envVars.description: Browser locale, e.g. en-US.

envVars.name: SURF_TZ
envVars.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to system timezone.

envVars.name: SURF_HEADLESS
envVars.description: Controls Playwright extraction, compatibility, and recovery paths. Native search hides normal system Chrome and shows it only for CAPTCHA recovery.

envVars.name: SURF_IDLE_CLOSE_MS
envVars.description: Idle ms before closing the sequential ctx and pool. 0 disables idle auto-close. Defaults to 30000.

envVars.name: SURF_ALLOW_PRIVATE
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to allow extract on private/loopback addresses (localhost, 10.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x, etc). Default blocks them as an SSRF guard.

envVars.name: SURF_LLM_HEAL
envVars.description: Enable the optional workflow-only LLM selector repair path. Defaults to false.

envVars.name: SURF_LLM_PROVIDER
envVars.description: LLM selector repair provider: anthropic or orcarouter. Defaults to anthropic.

envVars.name: SURF_LLM_MODEL
envVars.description: Optional model override. OrcaRouter defaults to orcarouter/auto.

envVars.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
envVars.description: Anthropic API key for optional LLM-assisted selector repair.

envVars.name: ORCAROUTER_API_KEY
envVars.description: OrcaRouter API key for optional LLM-assisted selector repair.

description: Read, search and edit any MediaWiki wiki, including Wikipedia and Fandom, with multi-wiki support and Semantic MediaWiki, Cargo, Wikibase and NeoWiki queries.

envVars.name: CONFIG
envVars.description: Path to your configuration file

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_STATIC_FALLBACK
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to allow HTTP startup when config.json has static credentials. Otherwise the server refuses to start, preventing silent shared-identity fallback for unauthenticated requests.

envVars.name: MCP_CONTENT_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte cap for the content bodies and result blocks tools return (wikitext, rendered HTML, diffs, statement and row listings). An oversized response is truncated with a trailing marker describing what was left out.

envVars.name: MCP_FILE_DATA_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Hard cap on the base64-encoded size of a get-file-data response. A transport/safety backstop; callers tune actual size with the tool's width parameter. Over-cap responses error rather than truncate.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Minimum severity for logger output (stderr telemetry and sendLoggingMessage broadcast). Invalid values fail loudly on first log call.

envVars.name: MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY
envVars.description: Maximum HTTP request body size on the StreamableHTTP transport. Accepts size strings like 1mb or 512kb.

envVars.name: MCP_METRICS
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to expose Prometheus metrics at GET /metrics on the HTTP transport. Has no effect on the stdio transport.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECTS
envVars.description: Additional allowed redirect URIs for hosted-proxy client registration: comma-separated exact URIs (which must include a host) and https prefix patterns ending in /*. Loopback, claude.ai, and verified first-party clients (ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code) are always allowed; unset means no additional clients.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_CIMD_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated additional client_id document hosts trusted for CIMD (bare host or host:port). Verified first-party hosts are always trusted.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_FILE
envVars.description: Override the default OAuth credentials store path. Default: ~/.config/mediawiki-mcp/credentials.json on Linux/macOS, %APPDATA%\mediawiki-mcp\credentials.json on Windows.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_NO_BROWSER
envVars.description: Set to '1' to skip launching a browser during the OAuth dance and log the auth URL to stderr instead. Useful in headless environments and CI.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_PROXY_STORE_FILE
envVars.description: Path to the hosted OAuth proxy's encrypted state file, which lets sign-ins survive restarts. Default: proxy-store.enc under the mediawiki-mcp config dir; /app/data/proxy-store.enc in the Docker image.

envVars.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Override the request-derived public URL used in the protected-resource discovery doc and WWW-Authenticate header. Set this when running behind a proxy that rewrites the request Host.

envVars.name: MCP_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS
envVars.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for in-flight /mcp calls to drain on SIGTERM/SIGINT before exiting. Capped at 600000.

envVars.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Type of MCP server transport

envVars.name: MCP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Memory cap on the server-side fetch used by upload-file-from-url and update-file-from-url. Files larger than this are routed to the wiki's own copy-upload instead of being buffered by the server. Guards this server's memory, not the wiki's $wgMaxUploadSize.

envVars.name: MCP_USER_AGENT
envVars.description: Replaces the User-Agent header of every outbound request, which defaults to mediawiki-mcp-server/<version> (https://github.com/ProfessionalWiki/MediaWiki-MCP-Server). If you set it, give a name and an email or URL, e.g. 'ExampleBot/1.0 (bot@example.org)'.

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: Port used for StreamableHTTP transport

name: io.github.sfrangulov/minirag-mcp
description: Local-first RAG MCP server: hybrid search over a folder of your own documents

envVars.name: BASE_DIR
envVars.description: One document root; also the security boundary for file access. Defaults to the process working directory. Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

envVars.name: BASE_DIRS
envVars.description: JSON array of document roots, e.g. ["/docs/a", "/docs/b"]. Takes precedence over BASE_DIR. An invalid value is a hard configuration error.

envVars.name: DB_PATH
envVars.description: LanceDB index directory. Defaults to <first root>/.minirag/lancedb, so each corpus gets its own index.

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Embedding model cache. Defaults to the platform user cache dir, so the ~220 MB model is downloaded once and shared.

envVars.name: MODEL_NAME
envVars.description: fastembed model id. Changing it makes existing vectors incompatible with new queries; pair with a new DB_PATH or a full re-ingest.

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Per-file size limit in bytes, enforced before parsing.

envVars.name: CHUNK_TOKEN_BUDGET
envVars.description: Retrieval-unit size in the embedding model's own tokens. Range 16-128; the ceiling is the model's trained sequence length.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword weight in the weighted RRF fusion, range 0.0-1.0. 0 is vector-only; higher values raise the BM25 contribution.

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Result grouping filter. 'similar' keeps only the closest group; 'related' also keeps the next one. Unset means no grouping filter.

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Drop results whose vector distance exceeds this value. Lower is stricter. Unset means no distance filter.

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Keep chunks from at most this many best-scoring files. Unset means no per-file filter.

envVars.name: RAG_INSTRUCTIONS_APPEND
envVars.description: Extra paragraph appended to the instructions the server hands the client at connect time, for corpus-specific guidance.

envVars.name: ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
envVars.description: Let ingest_url fetch hosts resolving to loopback, link-local, private, reserved or unspecified addresses. Off by default.

envVars.name: EARVELDAJA_LOG_FILE
envVars.description: Absolute path to a regular file. When set, everything the server writes to stderr is also appended to this file (mode 0o600). Off by default. Cross-platform. description: Computer use for Hyprland: semantic desktop state over IPC, plus vision and native input

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_SCREENSHOT_MODE
envVars.description: How captures are returned: 'file' writes to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and returns the path, 'image' returns the image inline. Use 'image' for clients that render MCP images but cannot read files, such as Claude Desktop.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_READONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose only the observation tools (desktop, screenshot, zoom, ui, marks, binds, wait_for). The agent can see and narrate but cannot click, type, or launch.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_CONFINE
envVars.description: Restrict input to a scope of windows and refuse everything outside it: 'launched' (only windows hypruse opened this session), 'class:firefox,kitty', or 'workspace:3,special:notes'. Unset means no confinement.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_AUTH_GUARD
envVars.description: Refuse to click or type into system authentication dialogs (polkit, keyring prompts). On by default; 'strict' also refuses password fields in ordinary windows; 0 disables it.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_STRICT
envVars.description: Set to 1 to refuse to act when the cursor or focused window moved since hypruse's last action, so the agent must re-read the desktop before retrying.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_MARK
envVars.description: Set to 1 to make the agent's presence legible: tag every window it opens 'hypruse-owned' and flash an on-screen notice when it opens a window or captures the screen.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD
envVars.description: Set to 1 to register the opt-in clipboard tool (never in read-only mode). Off by default because clipboards hold passwords.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL
envVars.description: Record every tool call, refusals included, as one NDJSON line: 1 writes to XDG_STATE_HOME/hypruse/journal.ndjson, or give a path. Read it back with 'hypruse journal'. Off by default.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Rotate the journal once it reaches this size, keeping one previous generation alongside it. Set 0 to never rotate.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_TEXT
envVars.description: Set to 1 to record typed and copied text in the journal verbatim instead of as a length plus digest. Off by default because keystrokes are passwords; needed only to replay typing.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_DRYRUN
envVars.description: Set to 1 for a rehearsal: every acting tool validates its arguments and runs every trust guard, then reports what it would have done and delivers no input.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
envVars.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` (with a warning) on a host where that directory is not usable.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SERVER_NAME
envVars.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION
envVars.description: Concise routing context that distinguishes this deployment's material or responsibility.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA
envVars.description: Deployment-specific behavioral policy added to the generated MCP instructions.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
envVars.description: Legacy: replaces all generated MCP instructions (deprecated; use _INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION for routing and _INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA for policy).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level for every logger in the process, FastMCP's included (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG. The unprefixed FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL still works for one major version and logs a deprecation warning.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LOG_FORMAT
envVars.description: Log rendering. rich is one colour event key=value line per record, for a terminal; json is one JSON object per record, for a collector. Unset picks rich when stderr is a terminal and json everywhere else, so a container or journald gets JSON with no configuration.

envVars.name: OLLAMA_HOST
envVars.description: Ollama server URL for the ollama embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the Ollama ecosystem convention.

envVars.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: OpenAI API key for the openai embedding provider, and the fallback key for the summarize tool when MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY is unset. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OpenAI ecosystem convention.

envVars.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY
envVars.description: Voyage AI API key for the voyage embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OPENAI_API_KEY / OLLAMA_HOST convention. Setting it never auto-selects the provider; choose it explicitly with MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=voyage.

envVars.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL (embeddings). For the summarize tool it only routes traffic when an API key already enables the feature; it never enables summarize by itself.

envVars.name: OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Maximum seconds an index-backed tool or resource waits for the FTS index to become queryable during a cold-start background build before raising IndexUnavailableError(reason="timeout"). Increase for large vaults.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Maximum seconds an index-querying read tool waits for the IndexWriter to drain when called with wait_for_pending_writes=true. On timeout the tool answers from the current index and reports index_stale=true in the response _meta.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SOURCE_DIR
envVars.description: Path to the markdown vault directory. When it does not exist, or the server cannot access it, the server starts but every tool fails with a message saying which until it is fixed (managed git mode clones into it). Symbolic links inside the vault are followed on Python 3.13+.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to true to hide the write tools (write, edit, append, delete, rename, move_folder, fetch, git_sync, the okf_* tools, create_upload_link) and serve a search-only vault.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_WRITE_PROTECT_EXISTING
envVars.description: Refuse a write that would overwrite an existing file when no if_match etag is supplied. Deliberate replacement still works: read the file first, then pass if_match. Unaffected: edit, append, delete, rename. Set to false to allow blind overwrites.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REPORT_UNRESOLVED_LINKS
envVars.description: Set to true to have write, edit and append list, under unresolved_links, the target of each link the call added that get_broken_links reports. Links the note already held are left out. Off by default, leaving those responses unchanged.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DISABLE_APPS_UI
envVars.description: Hide the MCP Apps UI tools (browse_vault, show_context) from the tool listing for clients that do not render MCP Apps panels.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEX_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the SQLite FTS5 index file; unset keeps the index in memory. Set it for persistence across restarts.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_STATE_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the change-tracking state file. Defaults to INDEX_PATH plus .state.json (index.db.state.json beside index.db); without INDEX_PATH the state is kept in memory. Never written into the vault by default.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDINGS_PATH
envVars.description: Base path for the embeddings files. Defaults beside INDEX_PATH (index-db-embeddings.npy and .json beside index.db); without INDEX_PATH the vectors are kept in memory and rebuilt at each start. Setting it also lets the provider be auto-detected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEXED_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields promoted to the tag index for structured filtering. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup; SEARCHABLE_FIELDS inherits this value when unset.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REQUIRED_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields required on every document; documents missing any are excluded from the index.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EXCLUDE
envVars.description: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded from scanning, e.g. .obsidian/**,.trash/**.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TITLE_FIELD
envVars.description: Frontmatter field used as the document title (falls back to title, the first H1, then the filename). Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SEARCHABLE_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields whose text values become keyword-searchable and enrich first-chunk embeddings. Inherits INDEXED_FIELDS when unset; the sentinel none means filterable but not searchable. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index and re-embeds once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TEMPLATES_FOLDER
envVars.description: Relative folder where note templates live (used by the create_from_template prompt).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_PROMPTS_FOLDER
envVars.description: Directory of .md prompt files that extend or override built-in prompts; a relative path is resolved against SOURCE_DIR.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CONVENTIONS_FILE
envVars.description: Filename of the per-folder conventions files surfaced to clients at write time (bare .md filename without glob characters). Set to none to disable folder conventions.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_MODE
envVars.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) read semantics. With auto (the default), read annotations switch on when the vault declares an OKF version in its root index.md. Use off to disable OKF semantics entirely, or on to force them for an undeclared vault. Annotations are read-only; write behavior is never affected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_WRITE
envVars.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) enforced write layer. When true on an OKF-active vault, the server stamps generated provenance on each write and clears any verified attestation when a note's content changes. It also keeps each written folder's log.md and index.md current, and exposes the okf_verify tool. Requires OKF_MODE to be auto or on (a true value with OKF_MODE=off is a config error). Off by default.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_VERIFY
envVars.description: How the okf_verify tool attributes a human review. This applies only when OKF_WRITE is on, which gates the tool. With elicit (the default), okf_verify asks the human to confirm the review through an MCP elicitation, then records the attestation only on an affirmative reply. It fails closed when the client cannot elicit or the human declines, so a model holding the human's token cannot self-attest. Set trust-auth instead to attribute to a token's sub claim with no confirmation; it rejects static bearer credentials and other client-ID-only identities. This is safe only when the sole caller is a human-driven UI. Set off to hide the tool, leaving attestation to external tooling. A non-default value with OKF_WRITE off is a config error.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed attachment extensions (e.g. pdf,png,jpg); case and a leading dot are ignored, so PDF and .pdf name the same type. Use * to allow every non-markdown file. Unset selects the built-in allowlist. A link whose target has a listed extension is not part of the link graph; changing the list rebuilds the index once.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Maximum attachment size in MB returned by read / accepted by write; 0 disables the limit.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_NOTE_READ_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum bytes returned by a full-document read of a note; use `read(path, section=…)` for partial reads. 0 disables the limit.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DEFAULT_SEARCH_MODE
envVars.description: Mode used when a search call omits 'mode': auto, keyword, semantic, or hybrid. The default 'auto' picks hybrid when embeddings are configured and keyword when they are not. Pin 'keyword' to keep unqualified searches off the embedding provider (each hybrid or semantic search embeds the query, which costs an API call on a metered provider). A configured semantic/hybrid default also degrades to keyword without embeddings, so no setting can make a vault unsearchable; an explicit mode= argument is never downgraded.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNKS_PER_FILE
envVars.description: Maximum chunks returned per document in search results.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SNIPPET_WORDS
envVars.description: Width of the snippet window (words) in search results; 0 returns full chunk content.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LENGTH_DOWNWEIGHT_ALPHA
envVars.description: Down-weights longer chunks in ranking: score / (1 + alpha * log(chunk_count)).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_WORDS
envVars.description: Word cap per chunk; the adaptive chunker splits at deeper heading levels, then paragraph/word boundaries, to respect it. Match it to the embedding model's context. A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_CHARS
envVars.description: Character cap enforced alongside MAX_CHUNK_WORDS to bound token-dense chunks. Unset derives min(1500, model context * 2.8). Set a positive value for an exact cap, or -1 to scale with the model's full context (can exhaust memory on long-context models). A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNK_OVERLAP_WORDS
envVars.description: Words of overlap between adjacent budget-split fragments of the same heading section (0 disables). A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FOLDER_WEIGHTS
envVars.description: Folder-prefix score multipliers (`prefix:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights > 0) applied to all search modes; the deepest matching prefix wins (sessions:0.5 demotes sessions/**).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FTS_WEIGHTS
envVars.description: Per-column BM25 weights (`column:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights >= 0) for keyword ranking. Columns: path, title, folder, heading, content, summary.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Embedding provider: openai, voyage, ollama, or fastembed; setting it turns on search by meaning. Unset auto-detects from the environment (never voyage), but only when EMBEDDINGS_PATH is set. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works with openai plus OPENAI_BASE_URL; see the embeddings guide.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_MODEL
envVars.description: Ollama embedding model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_CPU_ONLY
envVars.description: Force Ollama to embed on CPU only.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_VOYAGE_MODEL
envVars.description: Voyage AI embedding model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for embeddings; the bare OPENAI_BASE_URL is honoured as a fallback.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible embedding model name; the bare OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL is honoured as a fallback.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_MODEL
envVars.description: FastEmbed model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: FastEmbed model cache directory (in Docker, stored under /data/state/fastembed).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_CONTEXT
envVars.description: Enrich embedding input with the note title, chunk heading, and (first chunk) searchable-field values. Flipping it re-embeds the whole vault once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single embedding HTTP call (OpenAI/Ollama). The local FastEmbed backend runs in-process with no network call and ignores this. CPU-only or large-model workloads may need 60-120 s; raise this if batches time out.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE
envVars.description: Number of chunks sent per embedding request. Smaller batches shorten each request (useful under a tight timeout on slow models) at the cost of more round-trips.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_TOKEN
envVars.description: Token/password for HTTPS git auth; remotes must be HTTPS when set.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_REPO_URL
envVars.description: HTTPS remote URL for managed git mode: the server clones into an empty SOURCE_DIR on startup (or validates an existing origin) and enables the pull loop, auto-commit, and deferred push.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_USERNAME
envVars.description: Username for HTTPS git auth prompts (x-access-token for GitHub, oauth2 for GitLab, the account name for Bitbucket).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PULL_INTERVAL_S
envVars.description: Seconds between git fetch + fast-forward update attempts; 0 disables periodic pull.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PUSH_DELAY_S
envVars.description: Seconds of write-idle time before pushing; 0 pushes only on shutdown.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME
envVars.description: Git committer name for auto-commits, and the author name too unless an OIDC claim supplies one; set this in Docker where git config user.name is empty.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL
envVars.description: Git committer email for auto-commits, and the author email too unless an OIDC claim supplies one.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME_CLAIM
envVars.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author name (e.g. name) when an OIDC token is present; the committer stays GIT_COMMIT_NAME. The claim is resolved when the tool call arrives and carried to the background commit, so it applies on every write. A configured claim the token does not carry is reported once at WARNING and the static identity is used.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL_CLAIM
envVars.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author email (e.g. email) when an OIDC token is present; the committer stays GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL. Resolved and carried the same way as the name claim.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_LFS
envVars.description: Run git lfs pull on startup to fetch LFS-tracked attachments; set to false for repos without LFS.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER
envVars.description: Watch the vault for external filesystem changes; auto-disabled when git pull is active or a webhook can deliver (HTTP/SSE transports only). Requires the file-watcher extra.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_DEBOUNCE_S
envVars.description: Seconds of quiet after the last filesystem event before reindexing.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_ROOT_FLOOR
envVars.description: Keep the non-recursive watch on the vault root; set false to register zero source-dir-rooted FSEvents streams (avoids repeated macOS access prompts on a home-rooted vault) at the cost of root-level files relying on scans.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BOOT_REINDEX
envVars.description: Reconcile offline changes at startup by reindexing once the initial build completes. Set false on a large vault to start without paying a full filesystem scan per server start; changes made while no server was running are then invisible until a reindex runs (the reindex tool, or 'markdown-vault-mcp reindex'). Note that `index_stale` reports writer idleness, not agreement with disk, so it reads false while the index may still differ from the vault.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: Shared secret for the GitHub push-event webhook; when set, mounts POST /github-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_TOKEN
envVars.description: Signing token for the GitLab push-event webhook (GitLab 19.0+); when set, mounts POST /gitlab-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events. GitLab generates this value; copy the `whsec_` token it shows under Generate signing token rather than inventing one. Deliveries are authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 over the webhook id, timestamp and body, and a delivery older than 5 minutes is rejected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN
envVars.description: Secret token for the GitLab push-event webhook, GitLab's plain-text form and the only one below 19.0; also mounts POST /gitlab-webhook. It proves nothing about the body and cannot expire, so prefer the signing token where the GitLab version offers it. Setting both accepts either, which is how an existing webhook migrates.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Summarization backend (only openai is recognised). Unset auto-detects: the backend activates when credentials or an explicit endpoint are present.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible summarize endpoint; the bare OPENAI_API_KEY is honoured as a fallback. Unset works for keyless local endpoints (Ollama).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL for the summarize tool; setting it enables the tool even without an API key. The bare OPENAI_BASE_URL routes traffic only when a key already enables the feature.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_MODEL
envVars.description: Chat model id used for summaries.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_TOKENS
envVars.description: Upper bound on generated tokens per summarize call; on reasoning models this budget also covers internal reasoning tokens.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_NOTES
envVars.description: Cap on the number of notes summarised in one call (subtree expansion truncates to this many).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_INPUT_CHARS
envVars.description: Aggregate cap on note characters sent to the model in one call; excess is truncated with a flag on the result.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single summarize backend call; keep it below the MCP client's request timeout so the server-side error wins the race.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S
envVars.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S
envVars.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S
envVars.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S
envVars.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_SOFT_DEADLINE_S
envVars.description: Seconds a long-running tool call may run in the foreground before it is promoted to a background job and a job handle is returned instead.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_RESULT_TTL_S
envVars.description: Seconds a background-job record (working or finished) is retained for polling before it expires from the store.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_MAX_PER_SUBJECT
envVars.description: Maximum live background jobs per calling subject; further promotions are rejected until older records expire.

description: Couchbase MCP Server - Enable AI agents to connect to and interact with Couchbase clusters.

envVars.name: CB_CONNECTION_STRING
envVars.description: Couchbase connection string. Required for connecting to the cluster.

envVars.name: CB_USERNAME
envVars.description: Couchbase database username. Required for basic authentication.

envVars.name: CB_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Couchbase database password. Required for basic authentication.

envVars.name: CB_CA_CERT_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase CA certificate path. Required for TLS authentication in non Capella clusters.

envVars.name: CB_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.

envVars.name: CB_CLIENT_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase client key path. Required for mTLS authentication.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE
envVars.description: Couchbase read only mode. Set to true to allow disable write operations across both KV and query. KV write tools are not loaded and SQL++ queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow data modification queries and tools.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio, http or sse). Default is stdio

envVars.name: CB_MCP_HOST
envVars.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Tools to disable. Accepts comma-separated tool names (e.g., 'tool_1,tool_2') or a file path containing one tool name per line.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Also accepts a file path containing one tool name per line. Requires the MCP client to support elicitation.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging level for the MCP server. One of off, debug, info, warning, error. Use 'off' to disable logging entirely. Invalid values fall back to info. Default is info.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS
envVars.description: Comma-separated list of log destinations. Allowed values: stderr, file. Include 'file' to write per-level log files; include 'stderr' to write to the console. Default is stderr.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_FILE
envVars.description: Base path for the per-level log files. One rotating file is written per level (e.g. mcp_server.info.log, mcp_server.error.log). Only used when 'file' is in CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS. Default is mcp_server.log.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Global maximum size in MB per-level log file before it rotates, inherited by every level unless overridden by a per-level CB_MCP_LOG_<LEVEL>_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default (1 MB) with a startup warning. Default is 1 (1 MB).

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: [DEPRECATED] Global rotation size in bytes; use CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB (MB) instead. Still honored for backward compatibility but ignored when CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB is also set. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for ERROR; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for WARNING; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for INFO; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for DEBUG; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Number of rotated backup files kept per-level log file, excluding the live file. Applies to every level unless overridden per level. Set to 0 to keep only the live file (still capped by the rotation size). Default is 1.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for ERROR; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for WARNING; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for INFO; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for DEBUG; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI
envVars.description: JWKS endpoint of the identity provider used to verify bearer JWT signatures. Required to enable OAuth, along with CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER and CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE. Only honored when CB_MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: Expected JWT 'iss' claim value. Also advertised as the authorization server in Protected Resource Metadata when CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL is set. Required to enable OAuth.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected JWT 'aud' claim value. Required to enable OAuth.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ALGORITHM
envVars.description: JWT signing algorithm. One of RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512. Default is RS256.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Public base URL of this MCP server. When set, the server publishes RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata at <base_url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp so PRM-aware clients can discover the authorization server. Optional.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'read' access; advertised in PRM and matched against the token's scope/scp claim. Use when your IdP cannot emit the canonical form. Default is couchbase-mcp:read.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_WRITE_LABEL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'write' access; same semantics as CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL. Default is couchbase-mcp:write.

name: aliasunder/vault-cortex
description: Standalone Obsidian vault server: hybrid search, notes and files, memory and tasks; run locally or self-host for remote access.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token for MCP client authentication. Must match the Authorization header sent by clients. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

envVars.name: PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Public URL clients use to reach this server. Used as the OAuth issuer URL in discovery metadata. Override when exposing the server outside localhost or on a non-default port.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable the embedding pipeline. When false, no ONNX model is downloaded, no vector tables are created, and search uses FTS5 only.

envVars.name: RERANK_MODE
envVars.description: Cross-encoder reranking mode: blended (position-aware score blending after RRF fusion) or none (skip reranking). Only takes effect when EMBEDDING_ENABLED is true.

envVars.name: WINDOWS_MODE
envVars.description: Windows bind-mount mode: enables filesystem polling for the file watcher and rename-based moves across the Docker Desktop/WSL2 bridge. Set to true when the vault lives on a Windows drive.

envVars.name: MEMORY_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable the structured memory layer. When false, memory tools are hidden, bootstrap is skipped, and server metadata omits memory references.

envVars.name: FILE_TOOLS_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable file tools (vault_read_file, vault_list_files). When false, file tools are hidden and server metadata omits file tool references.

envVars.name: READONLY_MODE
envVars.description: Run the server read-only: every vault-writing tool is hidden, the memory folder is not auto-created, and server metadata omits write references.

envVars.name: DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Hide individual tools by name, comma-separated. Subtractive only — it cannot re-enable a tool another setting hides; an unknown tool name stops the server at startup.

envVars.name: MEMORY_DIR
envVars.description: Vault folder for structured memory files (About Me-style notes). Memory tools are hidden when MEMORY_ENABLED is false, but this value still feeds the defaults for PROTECTED_PATHS and ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS.

envVars.name: DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER
envVars.description: Vault folder for daily notes. Overrides the folder configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json (an empty folder there follows Obsidian's new-note location), falling back to "Daily Notes" when that file is missing or unreadable. Set to / for the vault root.

envVars.name: DAILY_NOTES_FORMAT
envVars.description: Filename date format for daily notes (Moment.js tokens). Overrides the format configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json, falling back to "YYYY-MM-DD".

envVars.name: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS
envVars.description: Number of trusted reverse-proxy hops used to derive the client IP from X-Forwarded-For for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. With 0, injected forwarding headers are ignored.

envVars.name: TRUST_FORWARDED_HOPS
envVars.description: How many entries from the end of the RFC 7239 Forwarded header's for= list to count to reach the client IP for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. 0 ignores the header; 1 when the proxy in front writes it (e.g. AWS API Gateway); 2 when a CDN fronts that proxy and is the only way to reach it.

envVars.name: TZ
envVars.description: IANA timezone for timestamps and daily note resolution.

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging verbosity.

envVars.name: LOG_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for log files that survive container re-creation. The container's own log is always written but discarded when the container is recreated; date-stamped files under LOG_DIR persist on the data volume. Default: /data/logs (remote image), $STORAGE_ROOT/data/logs (single-volume mode), none (local image). none keeps only the container log.

envVars.name: LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
envVars.description: Days to keep log files before automatic cleanup on startup; only applies when LOG_DIR is a path.

envVars.name: PROTECTED_PATHS
envVars.description: Comma-separated vault folder names blocked from vault_delete_note and vault_move_note. Default: MEMORY_DIR plus the daily notes folder, read from DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER or .obsidian/daily-notes.json (default Daily Notes; none when that setting is the vault root or empty). When set, overrides the default entirely.

envVars.name: ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS
envVars.description: Comma-separated vault folder names excluded from vault_find_orphans. Default: the daily notes folder, "Templates", and MEMORY_DIR. DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER wins; otherwise .obsidian/daily-notes.json is read per query (fallback "Daily Notes"; no daily folder when that setting is the vault root or empty). When set, replaces the defaults entirely. Set to a comma (,) to exclude nothing; an empty value uses the defaults.

envVars.name: SERVICE_DOCUMENTATION_URL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth service documentation URL exposed via discovery metadata.

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_BYTES
envVars.description: Largest file vault_read_file will read, in bytes. Reading a larger file returns an error instead of content.

envVars.name: MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for images returned by vault_read_file, in binary bytes before base64 encoding. Images exceeding the budget are downscaled/recompressed server-side to fit; raise for clients that accept larger tool responses.

envVars.name: MAX_PDF_RENDER_PAGES
envVars.description: Maximum PDF pages to render as images when raw: true is set on vault_read_file. The per-page byte budget is MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES divided evenly across the rendered pages.

envVars.name: WHATSAPP_BACKEND
envVars.description: WhatsApp backend: webjs uses a persistent browser profile; baileys connects without a browser and requires separate pairing

envVars.name: BAILEYS_SESSION_DIR
envVars.description: Baileys credentials and synchronized history directory (default: <working directory>/baileys-sessions). Use a private absolute path, owned by one server process.

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level for the log file (logs/mcp-whatsapp.log)

envVars.name: LOG_STDERR_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level for stderr (visible in most MCP client logs)

envVars.name: WHATSAPP_HEADLESS
envVars.description: webjs only: set to false to show the browser window instead of running headless

envVars.name: WHATSAPP_NO_SANDBOX
envVars.description: webjs only: explicitly disable the browser sandbox for containers that require it. The sandbox is enabled by default.

envVars.name: BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH
envVars.description: webjs only: browser executable. Chrome and Edge are auto-detected; set this to use a specific browser. Chrome/Edge is required for sending videos and GIFs.

envVars.name: WHATSAPP_SESSION_DIR
envVars.description: webjs only: persistent browser profile directory (default: <working directory>/whatsapp-sessions)

envVars.name: WHATSAPP_PAIRING_PHONE_NUMBER
envVars.description: Phone number pairing: when set (international, symbol-free format, e.g. 4915112345678), an 8-character pairing code is logged to stderr on startup instead of relying on the QR code

envVars.name: FFMPEG_PATH
envVars.description: Path to an ffmpeg binary (only needed to override the ffmpeg installed automatically via the ffmpeg-static npm package)

envVars.name: WA_WEB_VERSION
envVars.description: webjs only: pin the WhatsApp Web version if a WhatsApp-side update breaks the client.

envVars.name: HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS
envVars.description: webjs only: connection health check interval in milliseconds (<=0 disables)

envVars.name: TOOL_READY_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: How long tool calls wait for the WhatsApp client to become ready before erroring

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: When set, additionally exposes the MCP endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp (Streamable HTTP) from the same process

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Bind address for the HTTP endpoint (do not expose publicly; the endpoint controls your personal WhatsApp account)

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH
envVars.description: Enable OAuth for the HTTP endpoint: /mcp requires a bearer token and clients authenticate via a browser page showing the WhatsApp QR code / pairing form

description: Safe-by-default UniFi MCP: Network + Protect + Access, multi-site, dry-run, audit log.

envVars.name: STUB_MODE
envVars.description: When true, the server returns realistic mock data and requires no UniFi hardware. Defaults to true so the image is functional out of the box.

envVars.name: UNIFI_HOST
envVars.description: IP address or hostname of the UniFi OS gateway (UCG-Fiber, UDM Pro, etc). Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset.

envVars.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
envVars.description: Local API key generated under Settings -> Control Plane -> Integrations on the gateway. Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset.

envVars.name: UNIFI_SITE
envVars.description: UniFi controller site name. Defaults to 'default'.

envVars.name: UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL
envVars.description: Whether to verify the gateway's TLS certificate. Defaults to false because most home gateways use a self-signed cert.

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a YAML file describing multiple named controllers for multi-site management. When set, the legacy UNIFI_HOST / UNIFI_API_KEY env vars are ignored. Each entry needs name, host, api_key, and optionally port, site, verify_ssl.

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_MODULES_ENABLED
envVars.description: Comma-separated list of modules to load. Known values: 'network', 'protect', 'access'. Defaults to 'network'. Set to 'network,protect,access' to enable Protect and Access tools alongside Network. Access currently ships read-only; door unlocks and credential issuance require session-token auth and are deferred.

envVars.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_HOST
envVars.description: UniFi Access hub IP or hostname. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false. Often the same host as UNIFI_HOST.

envVars.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_API_KEY
envVars.description: UniFi Access API key. Separate from the Network API key; generated on the Access controller's developer settings. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false.

envVars.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_PORT
envVars.description: HTTPS port for the Access hub. Defaults to 12445 (the direct Access app port).

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK
envVars.description: Audit log sink. One of 'file' (default), 'stdout', or 'syslog'. Every tool call is recorded to a JSONL stream with secrets scrubbed.

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_PATH
envVars.description: Path for the audit log file when MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK=file. Defaults to audit.jsonl in the process CWD.

description: Access PostgreSQL databases, including those behind an SSH bastion.

envVars.name: DATABASE_URL
envVars.description: Full connection string (preferred). Supports sslmode in the URL.

envVars.name: PG_HOST
envVars.description: Database host (fallback when DATABASE_URL is not set).

envVars.name: PG_PORT
envVars.description: Database port.

envVars.name: PG_USER
envVars.description: Database user.

envVars.name: PG_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Database password.

envVars.name: PG_DATABASE
envVars.description: Database name.

envVars.name: PG_ALLOW_WRITE
envVars.description: When true, execute performs writes and reads are sent directly. Off (default) is read-only: execute refuses writes and each read runs in a READ ONLY transaction.

envVars.name: PG_SSLMODE
envVars.description: TLS mode. require/allow/prefer encrypt without verifying the certificate; verify-ca/verify-full verify it (supply a CA via PG_SSL_CA). Unlike libpq, allow/prefer do not fall back to plaintext, so a server without TLS needs disable.

envVars.name: PG_SSL_CA
envVars.description: Path to a CA certificate file. Setting it by itself implies verify-full.

envVars.name: PG_ENABLE_RUNTIME_CONNECT
envVars.description: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching).

envVars.name: PG_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept while they fit; over the budget returnedRows < rowCount and truncated is true.

envVars.name: PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session.

envVars.name: PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels).

envVars.name: PG_SSH_HOST
envVars.description: SSH bastion host. Setting it enables tunneling: the server reaches the database only through an SSH tunnel to this host. Needs the ssh2 optional dependency.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PORT
envVars.description: SSH bastion port.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_USER
envVars.description: SSH username.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Path to a private key file. If unset, auth falls back like ssh: a running agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then a default key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa).

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PASSPHRASE
envVars.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_AGENT
envVars.description: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PASSWORD
envVars.description: SSH login password. Opt-in; a key or agent takes precedence. Prefer keys, a bastion often disables password auth.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_FINGERPRINT
envVars.description: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:...). Host-key verification is mandatory and set only this way: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Get it with ssh-keygen -lF host.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
envVars.description: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects.

envVars.name: NTFY_SERVERS
envVars.description: JSON array of `{ baseUrl, authToken? | authUsername?+authPassword? }` entries — one per ntfy server. First entry is the default base. Auth is scoped to the entry's `baseUrl`; per-call `base_url` overrides that match a registered base forward that server's auth. Takes precedence over the single-server NTFY_BASE_URL / NTFY_AUTH_* shorthand.

envVars.name: NTFY_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Single-server shorthand — base URL of the ntfy server (no trailing slash). Used when NTFY_SERVERS is unset.

envVars.name: NTFY_DEFAULT_TOPIC
envVars.description: Topic used when a tool call omits `topic`. Treat the topic name as a secret — anyone who knows it can publish or subscribe.

envVars.name: NTFY_AUTH_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer access token (`tk_…`) for the single-server shorthand. Mutually exclusive with NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME / NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD.

envVars.name: NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME
envVars.description: Basic-auth username for the single-server shorthand — must be set together with NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD.

envVars.name: NTFY_AUTH_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Basic-auth password for the single-server shorthand — must be set together with NTFY_AUTH_USERNAME.

envVars.name: NTFY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-attempt HTTP timeout in milliseconds, covering the response body. Each call is also capped at 50 s across all attempts.

envVars.name: NTFY_MAX_RETRIES
envVars.description: Max retry attempts for transient upstream failures (5xx, network, 429).

envVars.name: NTFY_BLOCK_PRIVATE_HOSTS
envVars.description: When true, a per-call `base_url` override must resolve to a public address and its redirects are not followed. Servers registered under NTFY_SERVERS / NTFY_BASE_URL are exempt. Turn it on where callers you do not control can reach the server.

envVars.name: NTFY_ENABLE_EMOJI_TAGS
envVars.description: Set to false to disable the ntfy_search_emoji_tags tool: it leaves tools/list, and the server instructions and ntfy_publish_message stop pointing at it.

envVars.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
