envVars.name: SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a JSON file mapping destination names to system configs (url, client, authType basic/sso/sso2/oauth, credentials). Recommended; keep the file mode 0600. See systems.example.json

envVars.name: SAP_SYSTEMS
envVars.description: Inline JSON map of destinations (same shape as SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE). Contains credentials — prefer SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE

envVars.name: SAP_DEFAULT_DESTINATION
envVars.description: Destination name used when a tool call omits `destination` (alternatively mark an entry with "default": true)

envVars.name: SAP_AUTH_TYPE
envVars.description: Default auth type for entries that don't specify one: sso (default), sso2, basic, or oauth

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: When set (1024-65535), serve Streamable HTTP on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp with bearer-token auth instead of stdio

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Bind address for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1). Set 0.0.0.0 only inside containers that publish the port

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token for the HTTP transport; auto-generated and written to ~/.abap-adt-mcp/http-token when unset

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_SESSIONS
envVars.description: Maximum concurrent MCP sessions on the HTTP transport (default 16); further initialize requests get 503

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Largest request body the HTTP transport accepts, in bytes (default 4194304); larger bodies are refused with HTTP 413

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES
envVars.description: Idle minutes after which an HTTP session (and its SAP sessions/locks) is closed (default 30)

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Origin values allowed on the HTTP transport (loopback origins always allowed when bound to loopback; * allows any)

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Host header values allowed (DNS-rebinding protection; loopback hosts always allowed when bound to loopback)

envVars.name: MCP_EXPORT_ROOT
envVars.description: When set, exportPackageSources may only write inside this directory

envVars.name: MCP_AUDIT_FILE
envVars.description: Path of a JSONL audit trail: one record per tool call (tool, destination, duration, outcome ok/error/denied/unavailable, policy gate, redacted argument summary)

envVars.name: MCP_ADT_TRACE_FILE
envVars.description: Diagnostics: path of a JSONL trace with one line per ADT request (method, URI, status, headers). Cookie, Set-Cookie, Authorization and CSRF values are reduced to name and length; no response body is kept, error lines carry the first 300 characters of the redacted error text. Off when unset.

envVars.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to make every destination read-only (server-side; only read-only annotated tools plus login/logout run). Per-destination policies live in systems.json

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_DATA_PREVIEW
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let tableContents read table and CDS rows on every destination that does not state policy.allowDataPreview itself (reading table data is off by default)

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_FREE_SQL
envVars.description: Set to 1 to allow runQuery and tableContents with sqlQuery on every destination that does not state policy.allowFreeSql itself (free SQL is off by default; implies table data)

envVars.name: MCP_TOOLSETS
envVars.description: Toolsets to publish: comma list (core,source,objects,transports,analysis,tests,atc,data,discovery,runtime,refactoring,rap,services,git,debugger,traces) or a preset: all (default) or focused

envVars.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLSETS
envVars.description: Toolsets to hide, comma list (core cannot be disabled)

envVars.name: MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
envVars.description: Character budget for a single tool response before results are paged/truncated (default 40000, minimum 5000). Raise it if your MCP host accepts larger tool outputs

envVars.name: SAP_ALLOW_REENTRANCE_TICKET
envVars.description: Set to 1 to enable the reentranceTicket tool (disabled by default: it returns a live SAP logon credential into the conversation)

envVars.name: SAP_URL
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: base URL of the SAP system, e.g. https://host:44300

envVars.name: SAP_USER
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP username

envVars.name: SAP_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP password

envVars.name: SAP_CLIENT
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP client number, e.g. 100

envVars.name: SAP_LANGUAGE
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: logon language, e.g. EN

envVars.name: SAP_BROWSER_PATH
envVars.description: SSO destinations: path to a Chromium/Chrome/Edge binary for the browser login (auto-detected when unset)

envVars.name: SAP_BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR
envVars.description: SSO destinations: directory of the persistent browser profile that keeps the identity-provider session (default ~/.abap-adt-mcp/sso/<host>)

envVars.name: SAP_SSO2_COMMAND
envVars.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: absolute path to the trusted local ticket provider

envVars.name: SAP_SSO2_ARGS
envVars.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: JSON array of provider arguments (never put a ticket here)

envVars.name: SAP_SSO2_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: provider timeout in milliseconds (default 30000; range 1000-300000)

envVars.name: SAP_TLS_INSECURE
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification for that system only (sandboxes with self-signed certificates)

envVars.name: SAP_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 token endpoint (client_credentials)

envVars.name: SAP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 client id

envVars.name: SAP_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 client secret

envVars.name: SAP_OAUTH_SCOPE
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: optional OAuth2 scope

envVars.name: MCP_PROFILE_GATE
envVars.description: Platform gate for toolsets the destination does not expose (debugger, traces, abapGit, ...): enforce (default, refuse before calling SAP), warn (log only) or off

envVars.name: MCP_SOURCE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
envVars.description: Lifetime of the per-session source cache used by grepPackage, cdsViewInfo and syntaxCheckCode (default 300; 0 keeps entries until logout)

envVars.name: MCP_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for the cached SAP cloudification repository used by apiReleaseState (default ~/.abap-adt-mcp/cache)

envVars.name: MCP_API_CLASSIFICATION_FILES
envVars.description: Extra classification files for apiReleaseState, comma list: a path inside SAP's cloudification repository (partner/objectClassifications_ACME.json) or an https URL

name: io.github.chrischall/ofw-mcp
description: OurFamilyWizard co-parenting for Claude — messages, calendar, expenses, and journal

envVars.name: OFW_USERNAME
envVars.description: Your OurFamilyWizard login email address. Optional — if omitted, the server falls back to the fetchproxy browser extension (requires being signed in to ourfamilywizard.com).

envVars.name: OFW_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Your OurFamilyWizard password. Optional — see OFW_USERNAME.

envVars.name: OFW_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: Write-tool gate: "none" registers no write tools; "drafts" registers draft-level writes only (save/delete drafts, upload attachments); "all" registers everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

envVars.name: OFW_CALENDAR_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to "true" to register calendar write tools (create/update/delete event) in "drafts" write mode. Events have no draft stage but are reversible. Never overrides "none".

envVars.name: OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ
envVars.description: Default "true". Set "false" to forbid any tool from marking a message read on OurFamilyWizard - reading a body for the first time stamps a co-parent-visible "First Viewed" time that cannot be undone. A ceiling: no per-call argument can raise it.

envVars.name: OFW_FETCH_UNREAD_BODIES
envVars.description: Default "false". Whether ofw_sync_messages fetches unread inbox bodies by default (each fetch stamps a First Viewed time). Capped by OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ.

envVars.name: OFW_READ_DAYS
envVars.description: Allow list of days message content may be read, e.g. "mon,thu" (weekdays, YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD, in DISPLAY_TZ). Other days: subjects only, nothing marked read. Unset = every day.

envVars.name: OFW_NO_READ_DAYS
envVars.description: Deny list of days message content may NOT be read (same format as OFW_READ_DAYS; wins over it). Unset = none.

envVars.name: OFW_SESSION_CACHE
envVars.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

envVars.name: OFW_SESSION_FILE
envVars.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.ofw-mcp/session.json.

envVars.name: OFW_EXPENSE_ONLY
envVars.description: Set true to register only healthcheck plus expense tools. All profile/dashboard, message, calendar, and journal tools are structurally absent.

envVars.name: OFW_EXPENSE_UPLOAD_ONLY
envVars.description: Set true for strict reimbursement upload mode: only healthcheck, ofw_upload_expense_pdf, ofw_create_expense, and ofw_update_expense register. Excludes ofw_mark_expense_reimbursed. Implies OFW_EXPENSE_ONLY.

envVars.name: OFW_INLINE_ATTACHMENTS
envVars.description: Set "true" to return attachments as MCP content blocks by default (images render directly; other files come back as embedded resources) instead of writing to disk. Callers can still override per call via the tool's `inline` argument.

envVars.name: OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR
envVars.description: Where ofw_download_attachment writes (default ~/Downloads/ofw-mcp). Every disk write is confined to it: a saveTo outside it (after resolving symlinks) is refused, and an existing file is replaced only with force:true.

envVars.name: OFW_UPLOAD_DIR
envVars.description: The only directory ofw_upload_attachment may read from (default: OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR). Paths outside it after resolving symlinks, hidden files/dirs, and files over 25 MiB are refused.

envVars.name: OFW_CACHE_IDENTITY
envVars.description: Explicit cache-key label; overrides OFW_USERNAME for fetchproxy-only multi-account setups. If you have multiple OFW accounts and want them to use separate caches, set it to a label per profile.

envVars.name: OFW_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Overrides the message cache directory (default ~/.cache/ofw-mcp).

envVars.name: OFW_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
envVars.description: Skip the fetchproxy fallback, so missing credentials become a hard error (useful in headless CI).

envVars.name: OFW_AUTO_REFRESH
envVars.description: When a cached read comes back EMPTY from a non-fresh cache, the read tools sync the backing folders and answer from the refreshed cache instead of refusing with UNVERIFIED_EMPTY (default off, i.e. refuse). Per-call autoRefresh overrides it. A refresh that does not make the read verifiable still refuses.

envVars.name: OFW_FRESHNESS_TTL_SECONDS
envVars.description: How long a verified-against-OFW folder stays labelled `fresh` in read tools' `freshness` block (default 300). Unusable values fall back to the default — a typo must never widen the window in which stale data reads as current.

envVars.name: OFW_SYNC_MAX_REQUESTS
envVars.description: Per-call OFW-request budget for ofw_sync_messages: a positive integer caps how many OFW requests one sync call may make before pausing; the next call resumes where it left off. Unset means unbounded (local installs walk fully in one call).

envVars.name: OFW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout for OFW API calls, in milliseconds (default 30000). Each retry gets its own fresh window.

envVars.name: OFW_DEBUG_LOG
envVars.description: Log every OFW request/response to stderr (Authorization redacted). Diagnostic only.

envVars.name: DISPLAY_TZ
envVars.description: IANA zone (e.g. America/New_York, the default) for every `<field>Display` value, and the zone a NAIVE source timestamp is assumed to be wall-clock in. OFW's API reports naive local times in the account's own zone, so this must match it. Unrecognized values fall back to the default.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
envVars.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
envVars.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

description: Obsidian MCP server: semantic search, knowledge graph, and vault editing. No plugin required.

envVars.name: VAULT_PATH
envVars.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (or any folder of .md files).

envVars.name: DATA_DIR
envVars.description: Where to store the SQLite index + embedding cache. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/obsidian-brain or ~/.local/share/obsidian-brain.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_PRESET
envVars.description: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1.5), english-fast, english-quality, multilingual, multilingual-quality, multilingual-ollama. Ignored when EMBEDDING_MODEL is set.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: Power-user override: any transformers.js checkpoint or Ollama model id. Takes precedence over EMBEDDING_PRESET. Switching auto-reindexes.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Embedding backend. 'transformers' (local, default) or 'ollama' (requires a running Ollama server).

envVars.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server. Only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.

envVars.name: OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIM
envVars.description: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. If unset, the server probes the model on startup.

envVars.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX
envVars.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL
envVars.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_BYOM_AUTO_PULL
envVars.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH
envVars.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP
envVars.description: Set to '1' to skip the startup catchup reindex pass that picks up edits made while the server was down. The live file watcher still starts (via OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH=1 to disable that separately), and first-time indexing on an empty DB is unaffected — this knob only governs the post-restart `enqueueBackgroundReindex` walk.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS
envVars.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_COMMUNITY_DEBOUNCE_MS
envVars.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS
envVars.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR
envVars.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_DEBUG
envVars.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_LOG_FORMAT
envVars.description: Set to 'ndjson' for one-JSON-object-per-line stderr output (timestamp + level + message + structured fields). Default is human-readable plain text (`obsidian-brain: <message>`). Useful for piping logs into aggregators (Datadog, Loki, Vector, journald) that index structured fields.

name: io.github.damoqiongqiu/mcp-local-rag
description: Semantic code & doc search with keyword boost. AST code nav, auto HF mirror, local, privacy-first.

envVars.name: BASE_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

envVars.name: BASE_DIRS
envVars.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

envVars.name: DB_PATH
envVars.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

envVars.name: MODEL_NAME
envVars.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

envVars.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
envVars.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

envVars.name: RAG_DEVICE
envVars.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

envVars.name: RAG_DTYPE
envVars.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

envVars.name: RAG_WATCH
envVars.description: Enable automatic file watcher to detect changes and re-index modified files (true/1 to enable). Useful during active development.

envVars.name: HF_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Explicit HuggingFace endpoint URL to use for model downloads. When set, auto-mirror detection is skipped and this URL is used directly. Useful when you have a full-featured mirror.

envVars.name: HF_AUTO_MIRROR
envVars.description: Enable automatic mirror detection for HuggingFace downloads (defaults to true). Set to "false" or "0" to disable and use huggingface.co directly. The mirror chain is: huggingface.co → hf-mirror.com → modelscope.cn.

envVars.name: HTTPS_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTPS proxy URL for downloading embedding models (e.g. http://proxy:8080). Required only if behind a corporate proxy.

envVars.name: HTTP_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTP proxy URL for downloading embedding models. Fallback if HTTPS_PROXY is not set.

envVars.name: IONOS_TOKEN
envVars.description: IONOS CLOUD API token (required for all products except Object Storage)

envVars.name: IONOS_S3_ACCESS_KEY
envVars.description: S3 access key for IONOS Object Storage

envVars.name: IONOS_S3_SECRET_KEY
envVars.description: S3 secret key for IONOS Object Storage

envVars.name: IONOS_MCP_LOAD_MODE
envVars.description: Tool registration strategy (the --load-mode flag overrides this). 'eager' (default): register all tools at startup. 'lazy': defer Compute and Object Storage behind 'ionos_load_compute_tools' / 'ionos_load_objectstorage_tools' sentinel tools (requires MCP client support for notifications/tools/list_changed). 'dynamic' (alias 'search'): expose only the ionos_search_tools / ionos_describe_tools / ionos_call_tool meta-tools and browse the full catalog through them — for clients with hard tool caps and no tool search of their own (Cursor, Windsurf).

envVars.name: IONOS_MCP_TOOL_SCOPE
envVars.description: Opt in to write operations. Unset (default) leaves the server read-only: only list_/get_/head_ tools are registered. 'write' additionally registers create_/update_ tools and the non-disruptive actions (start_, resume_, attach_, assign_); 'destructive' also registers delete_ and the disruptive actions (stop_, reboot_, suspend_, upgrade_, restore_, detach_, recreate_, import_) and implies 'write'. Comma-separated, case-insensitive, hierarchical; unrecognised values stay read-only. WARNING: enabling this lets an AI model provision, modify and delete billable resources in a live IONOS CLOUD account. Every create and delete requires a two-phase confirmation, but that cannot stop a client configured to approve tool calls automatically. Leave unset unless writes are needed.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenGrok server base URL (e.g. https://opengrok.example.com/source/)

envVars.name: OPENGROK_USERNAME
envVars.description: OpenGrok authentication username. Leave unset for anonymous access.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD
envVars.description: OpenGrok authentication password. Prefer storing via OS keychain using 'npx opengrok-mcp-server setup'.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_VERIFY_SSL
envVars.description: Verify TLS certificates. Set to false for self-signed or internal CA certs.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_CODE_MODE
envVars.description: Enable Code Mode: 2-tool sandbox interface with env.opengrok.* JavaScript API. Reduces AI token usage by ~90%.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_MEMORY_TOOLS
envVars.description: Register the 3 memory tools in Code Mode (memory status, read, update). Off = api + execute only.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_PROJECT
envVars.description: Default project to scope all searches. Can be overridden per call.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_CONTEXT_BUDGET
envVars.description: Response size tier controlling token usage.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_API_VERSION
envVars.description: OpenGrok REST API version. Use v2 for call graph features (requires OpenGrok 1.12+).

envVars.name: HTTP_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for all OpenGrok API requests (e.g. http://proxy.company.com:8080). Also set as HTTPS_PROXY.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_RESPONSE_FORMAT_OVERRIDE
envVars.description: Force a specific response format for all tools. Leave unset for per-tool auto-selection (recommended).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_MEMORY_BANK_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where the AI stores investigation notes (active-task.md, investigation-log.md). Defaults to ~/.config/opengrok-mcp/memory-bank/ or workspace-relative when set by the VS Code extension.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_LOCAL_COMPILE_DB_PATHS
envVars.description: Comma-separated paths to compile_commands.json for C/C++ compiler flag and include-path extraction. Leave unset for automatic workspace discovery.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_ELICITATION
envVars.description: Interactive AI Prompts — the AI pauses to ask questions during investigations (project selection, file disambiguation). Requires Claude Code v2.1.76+ or a client that supports MCP Elicitation.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_SAMPLING
envVars.description: AI Sampling — allow the server to request LLM completions for error explanations and summaries. Off by default to avoid consuming premium requests (e.g. GitHub Copilot).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MODEL
envVars.description: Model preference for MCP Sampling (used for error explanation and query reformulation).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_FILES_API
envVars.description: Files API Cache — avoids re-uploading unchanged investigation notes. Requires Files API support in the MCP client.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_OBSERVATION_MASKER
envVars.description: Observation Masker — prepend compact history summaries to opengrok_execute results after N turns. Disabled by default; has no benefit for clients that retain full context (Claude Code, Cursor).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_OBSERVATION_MASKER_TURNS
envVars.description: Number of most-recent opengrok_execute results to keep as full text before masking older ones. Default: 10.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MAX_TOKENS
envVars.description: Maximum tokens for AI sampling responses (error explanation, query reformulation). Range: 64–4096.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_AUDIT_LOG_FILE
envVars.description: Path to write structured audit events (CSV/JSON). Appends tool invocations, elicitation events, and errors. Leave unset to disable.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM
envVars.description: Maximum requests per minute to the OpenGrok server. Default: 60.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_PER_TOOL_RATELIMIT
envVars.description: Per-tool rate limits in requests per minute, as comma-separated tool:rpm pairs (e.g. opengrok_execute:15,opengrok_search_code:30). Overrides OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM for specific tools.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for OpenGrok API calls. Increase for slow servers. Default: 30.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS
envVars.description: Default maximum number of results returned per search query. Default: 25.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file containing the OpenGrok password (file-mounted secret for containers). Takes precedence over the OS keychain when OPENGROK_PASSWORD is unset.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
envVars.description: Hard cap on response payload size in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default. Non-positive values are ignored.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_SEARCH_AND_READ_CAP
envVars.description: Cap for the search_and_read compound tool in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default (2–8 KB depending on tier). Non-positive values are ignored.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_STRICT_SSRF
envVars.description: When true, reject OPENGROK_BASE_URL values pointing at private/loopback IPs at startup. Default: false (warn only; per-request guards still apply).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: Expected JWT issuer (iss claim) for HTTP transport OAuth. When set, JWTs from other issuers are rejected.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_GRAMMAR_DIR
envVars.description: Directory containing tree-sitter WASM grammars. Overrides the bundled grammar lookup.

name: io.github.claymore666/ccu-mcp
description: MCP server for controlling HomeMatic smart home devices via the CCU JSON-RPC API

envVars.name: CCU_HOST
envVars.description: Hostname or IP of your HomeMatic CCU (debmatic, CCU3, or OpenCCU/RaspberryMatic)

envVars.name: CCU_PASSWORD
envVars.description: CCU admin password (same as the WebUI login). Must be set; the value may be empty for a CCU with no password

envVars.name: CCU_USER
envVars.description: CCU username

envVars.name: CCU_HTTPS
envVars.description: Connect to the CCU via HTTPS (self-signed certificates supported)

envVars.name: CCU_PORT
envVars.description: CCU API port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for the device type cache and session persistence

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of browser origins. Unset = no cross-origin browser access (default-deny). An allowlisted origin is reflected exactly in Access-Control-Allow-Origin (never '*'); the list also drives DNS-rebinding origin checks

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Extra Host header values accepted by DNS-rebinding protection (comma-separated host:port); add your hostname when behind a proxy or container DNS name

envVars.name: CCU_PROFILES
envVars.description: Comma-separated names of multiple CCU targets (e.g. 'prod,dev'). Each profile takes the flat CCU_* settings prefixed CCU_<NAME>_ (CCU_PROD_HOST, ...), plus policy flags CCU_<NAME>_PROTECTED (writes need confirm:true) and CCU_<NAME>_READONLY. Unset = single default profile from the flat CCU_* vars

envVars.name: CCU_DEFAULT_PROFILE
envVars.description: Which profile from CCU_PROFILES is active at startup (default: the first listed)

envVars.name: CCU_TLS_VERIFY
envVars.description: Verify the CCU's TLS certificate against the system trust store. Only meaningful with CCU_HTTPS=true. Default false, because a CCU ships a self-signed certificate — prefer CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT or CCU_CA_CERT to verify one of those

envVars.name: CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT
envVars.description: Pin the CCU's self-signed leaf certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional). The strongest option for an appliance: the connection is rejected unless the presented certificate matches. Takes precedence over CCU_CA_CERT

envVars.name: CCU_CA_CERT
envVars.description: Path to a PEM file holding the CCU's CA or self-signed certificate. The connection is then validated against it with standard chain verification

envVars.name: CCU_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout for a CCU JSON-RPC call, in MILLISECONDS

envVars.name: CCU_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout for HomeMatic Script execution (ReGa), in MILLISECONDS — scripts are slower than plain API calls

envVars.name: CACHE_TTL
envVars.description: Lifetime of the on-disk device-type schema cache, in SECONDS

envVars.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_BURST
envVars.description: Token-bucket burst size for CCU requests — how many may be issued back to back

envVars.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_RATE
envVars.description: Sustained CCU request rate, in requests per second

envVars.name: RESOURCE_POLL_INTERVAL
envVars.description: How often MCP resources are polled for change notifications, in SECONDS

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: error | warn | info | debug. Logs are structured JSON on stderr

description: Agent evaluation and observability: trace logging, output quality evaluation, cost tracking, built-in eval rules, a real-time dashboard and PII detection.

envVars.name: IRIS_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for HTTP authentication. Required to bind the HTTP transport or the dashboard beyond loopback (0.0.0.0, a LAN address, a container): without it the server refuses to start

envVars.name: IRIS_API_KEY_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file whose trimmed contents are the API key (the secret-file pattern Docker and Kubernetes mount). Set this or IRIS_API_KEY, not both; further keys and rotation are security.apiKeys in config.json

envVars.name: IRIS_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED
envVars.description: Set to 1 to run a non-loopback bind with NO API key on purpose (lifts the startup refusal; the network is then your boundary)

envVars.name: IRIS_DB_PATH
envVars.description: SQLite database path

envVars.name: IRIS_SQLITE_DRIVER
envVars.description: Which SQLite driver holds the database: native (better-sqlite3, the default) or node (Node's built-in node:sqlite, Node 22.13+). Unset: native, falling back to node when the native module cannot load

envVars.name: IRIS_SEARCH_BUDGET_MS
envVars.description: How long one trace search may read before it answers with the matches found so far, in milliseconds (50-60000, default 1000)

envVars.name: IRIS_SEARCH_INDEX
envVars.description: on (default) or off. off keeps no full-text index of the traces: writes are cheaper, and a search reads the traces within its time budget

envVars.name: IRIS_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error

envVars.name: IRIS_HOME
envVars.description: Directory for the database, custom rules and preferences (default ~/.iris)

envVars.name: IRIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
envVars.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an Anthropic model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key

envVars.name: IRIS_OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an OpenAI model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key

envVars.name: IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_MAX_COST_USD_PER_EVAL
envVars.description: Hard cap on the worst-case cost of one LLM judge call (default 0.25); max_cost_usd can lower it for a call, never raise it

envVars.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_MODEL
envVars.description: A priced judge model; answers_the_ask then asks it on every evaluation with input, sending that input and output to the model's provider, and gates on its verdict (off by default)

envVars.name: IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD
envVars.description: What every judge call together may spend per UTC day, per tenant, in USD (default 1): the relevance judge, evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations. Past it no judge call is made

envVars.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD
envVars.description: The name of IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD before 0.21.0. Read when the new name is unset, and it then limits every judge call

envVars.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_MAX_CALLS_PER_REQUEST
envVars.description: Relevance judge calls one request may make (default 20)

envVars.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_REDACT
envVars.description: on (default) replaces the PII and credentials no_pii flags before the relevance judge sends input and output to its provider; off sends them as they are

envVars.name: IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH
envVars.description: Let verify_citations fetch URLs (off by default); a tool argument can turn it off for a call, never on

envVars.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD
envVars.description: Start the dashboard alongside the server (same as --dashboard)

envVars.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_PORT
envVars.description: Dashboard port (default 6920); IRIS_PORT is the MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000)

envVars.name: IRIS_PORT
envVars.description: MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000); only used with --transport http

envVars.name: IRIS_OTEL_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: OTLP/HTTP collector URL; when set, every stored trace is also exported as OpenTelemetry spans (best-effort, asynchronous)

envVars.name: IRIS_CITATION_DOMAINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated domain allowlist for verify_citations fetches (only consulted when IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH is on); a tool argument can narrow it, never add to it

envVars.name: IRIS_CITATION_MAX_COST_USD_TOTAL
envVars.description: The most one verify_citations call may spend on judge calls, in USD (default 1); max_cost_usd_total can lower it, never raise it

envVars.name: IRIS_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport: stdio (default) or http; same as --transport

envVars.name: IRIS_HOST
envVars.description: Bind host for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1); only used with --transport http

envVars.name: IRIS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for the HTTP transport and dashboard CORS (default http://localhost:*)

envVars.name: IRIS_MAX_INPUT_ELEMENTS
envVars.description: The most array elements and object keys one input may hold before it is validated (default 100000): a tool call's arguments, and a dashboard or OTLP JSON request body. A tool call over it gets an error result; a body, 413. OTLP protobuf has its own ceiling, one element per 5 bytes of the request size limit

envVars.name: IRIS_MAX_TOOL_INPUT_ELEMENTS
envVars.description: The name of IRIS_MAX_INPUT_ELEMENTS before 0.21.0, read when the new name is unset

envVars.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_HOST
envVars.description: Bind host for the dashboard (default 127.0.0.1); same as --dashboard-host

envVars.name: IRIS_OTEL_HEADERS
envVars.description: Comma-separated key=value headers sent with every OTLP export (for example an auth token for your collector)

envVars.name: IRIS_OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
envVars.description: service.name resource attribute on exported spans (default iris-eval)

envVars.name: IRIS_OTEL_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each OTLP export request

envVars.name: IRIS_WEBHOOK_URL
envVars.description: The receiver of the webhook that fires on a moment (docs/webhooks.md); merged over notify.webhook in config.json

envVars.name: IRIS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: The signing key of that webhook (any string, or whsec_ + base64); the iris format refuses to run without one

envVars.description: Max rows per interactive query (default 500; ceiling 1000).

envVars.description: Interactive query command timeout in seconds (default 30).

envVars.description: Max rows for snapshot queries (default 10000; ceiling 50000).

envVars.description: Snapshot query timeout in seconds (default 120).

envVars.description: Execution plan analysis timeout in seconds (default 300; ceiling 600).

envVars.name: MCPMSSQL_ALLOW_WRITE
envVars.description: Enable write commands (DDL/DML) via run_command on the default profile (default false). With no write-enabled profile the tool is not advertised at all. Soft guard only — prefer a db_datareader login for a hard read-only guarantee.

envVars.name: MCPMSSQL_WRITE_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
envVars.description: Write command timeout in seconds (default 60; ceiling 600).

name: PipRail
description: Budget-bound x402 payment wallet for AI agents — pays HTTP 402 URLs, capped locally. No backend.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Your wallet's private key/seed for the chosen chain. Optional: omit it to run read-only (discover/quote/register/budget/guide); set it to let the agent pay. Stays on your machine; the spend policy caps every payment.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_CHAIN
envVars.description: Chain to pay on (default: base).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_CHAINS
envVars.description: Pay across several chains (instead of PIPRAIL_CHAIN): a comma-separated list, e.g. base,polygon,solana. Give each its own PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_KEY (+ optional PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_RPC_URL). The agent pays whichever chain a 402 asks for — the first listed that can settle — under one shared budget.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_AMOUNT
envVars.description: Max spend per single payment, in token units (default: 0.10).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL
envVars.description: Lifetime spend cap per token, in token units (default: 10.00).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL_DENOM
envVars.description: Cross-token GRAND TOTAL: one spend cap per denomination across every stablecoin and chain, e.g. USD:20.00,EUR:5.00. Not a price oracle — sums tokens of the same unit, each counted 1:1. Native coins are excluded.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS
envVars.description: Lifetime cap on the NUMBER of payments, across every chain + token (e.g. 100).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_WINDOW
envVars.description: Cap on the number of payments within PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS (a rolling rate limit; set PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS too).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_WARN_AT_FRACTION
envVars.description: Emit an early-warning event when spend crosses this fraction of any cap, e.g. 0.8 (80%). Needs PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG to be visible.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_SPEND_LOG
envVars.description: Path to a local append-only spend log. When set, the budget (lifetime, grand total, counts) SURVIVES a restart — hydrated from this file. No backend; you own the file.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG
envVars.description: Mirror payment events (settled / declined / budget-threshold) as one-line JSON to 'stderr' or a file path — the operator's notification stream. Default: off.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_TOKENS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed token symbols, plus the alias 'native' for the chain's coin (default: USDC).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_SCHEMES
envVars.description: Comma-separated payment schemes to settle (default: onchain-proof). Add 'exact' (onchain-proof,exact) to also pay standard x402 servers GASLESS on EVM + Solana (method auto-selected). Add 'upto' to also pay metered x402 servers on EVM (Permit2): sign a MAX, the server settles the actual <= max.

name: io.form/formio-mcp
description: Create and manage Form.io forms, resources, actions, roles, and projects from your AI agent.

envVars.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL
envVars.description: Optional, and the WEAKEST of the three project sources: a committed formio.json found by walking up from the working directory wins, then the per-directory mapping project_set writes, then this. It pins nothing — project_set can redirect a directory whose environment names a different project. Useful for a launch with nowhere to record a project, such as CI or a container (e.g. https://examples.form.io on the hosted cloud; self-hosted it is either https://your-project.your-domain.com or https://your-host/project-name, depending on how that deployment routes projects). Leave it unset and the agent asks for a project and records it per directory.

envVars.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Optional, and usually unnecessary: the base URL is DERIVED from the project URL — https://api.form.io for a project on a form.io host, the parent path for a project addressed as a sub-directory — and is asked for only when it cannot be derived, which is a path-less project URL on a customer domain. There is no default. Like FORMIO_PROJECT_URL it is the weakest source, behind a committed formio.json and the per-directory mapping.

envVars.name: FORMIO_API_KEY
envVars.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — applied only to the project FORMIO_PROJECT_URL names, so set FORMIO_PROJECT_URL beside it; any other project, and every project when it is omitted, uses the browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.

envVars.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM
envVars.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.

envVars.name: FORMIO_AUTH_HOST
envVars.description: Address the browser-login page binds to. Optional; defaults to 127.0.0.1. Set it to 0.0.0.0, together with FORMIO_AUTH_PORT, when the server runs in a container or on a remote machine and the login page must be reachable through a published port. 0.0.0.0 exposes the page on every interface for the duration of a login.

envVars.name: FORMIO_AUTH_PORT
envVars.description: Fixed port for the browser-login page, so a container can publish it (e.g. 43117). Optional; a positive integer, and by default the page takes an ephemeral port.

envVars.name: FORMIO_AUTH_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Seconds to wait for a browser login before the call fails with an error naming the remedies. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 900.

envVars.name: FORMIO_FORCE_BROWSER
envVars.description: Set to 1 to attempt the browser login even where the server detects it cannot present one (CI, a container, a remote shell with no display). Use it when the login page is reachable from a browser elsewhere.

envVars.name: FORMIO_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Seconds a Form.io request may go unanswered before the call fails with a network error naming the URL. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 60. project_import and project_export wait 300 seconds, or this value when it is longer.

envVars.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS
envVars.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification only for requests to the configured deployment (the hosts of the resolved project URL and base URL); every other host is verified as usual. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.

description: Geocode, reverse geocode, and run Overpass spatial queries on OpenStreetMap data.

envVars.name: OSM_NOMINATIM_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Nominatim API base URL. Override to use a private or mirror instance.

envVars.name: OSM_USER_AGENT
envVars.description: User-Agent sent to Nominatim and Overpass. Required by usage policy.

envVars.name: OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Overpass API endpoint URL. When set, pins every query to this one endpoint and disables mirror failover; OSM_OVERPASS_MAX_CONCURRENCY sizes it and a |N suffix is rejected. Leave unset to use OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS.

envVars.name: OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated ordered list of Overpass endpoints. A failure advances to the next entry within the same tool call; a single entry means no failover. An entry written url|N gets N slots of its own and adds capacity, for an instance whose operator allows parallel queries, never a public FOSSGIS server; an unsuffixed later entry is failover only. Write a | inside a URL as %7C. Verify a mirror's usage policy, data coverage, and freshness before adding it. Ignored when OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL is set.

envVars.name: OSM_OVERPASS_MAX_CONCURRENCY
envVars.description: Concurrent Overpass queries per endpoint: OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL, and every OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS entry not sized with |N. With no |N entry it is also the most queries in flight across all endpoints. A query waits at most 30 seconds in total for a slot, then fails with pacer_shed and a retryAfter. The default of 1 follows the public FOSSGIS instances, which allow one query in flight per user; raise it only for an instance whose operator allows parallel queries, such as a private or paid one.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

name: io.github.cyanheads/eurostat-mcp-server
description: Search and query the Eurostat catalogue — EU economy, demography, trade, and NUTS regional data.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_CLAMP_LIMITS
envVars.description: Clamp positive integer preview/search/dimension limits to 500/100/1000 with a notice. False restores schemas rejecting over-cap inputs.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Eurostat API base URL. Override when using a mirror or proxy.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_COMEXT_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of the Comext dissemination host, which serves every DS-* dataset code (detailed trade and PRODCOM). Override when using a mirror or proxy.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Total allowance for one Eurostat request across retries, backoff and body consumption, in milliseconds.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_METADATA_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Total allowance for one dataset's SDMX dataflow structure across retries, backoff and body consumption, in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000; separate from EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS for large structures.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_TOC_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: How long a fetched catalogue TOC stays usable before the next catalogue call refreshes it, in milliseconds. Defaults to 12 hours.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Total allowance for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer across request retries, backoff and streaming body consumption, in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, counted on the decoded TSV rather than on the wire. Eurostat sends the body chunked with no Content-Length, so the budget is enforced while streaming and the transfer is aborted when it is reached. Defaults to 50 MiB.

envVars.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
envVars.description: Dataframe canvas backend. The default, 'duckdb', lists eurostat_dataframe_describe and eurostat_dataframe_query, stages query matches with stage=true or above 5,000 observations, and retains bulk downloads beyond their previews. Set to 'none' to disable the canvas and those tools. The DuckDB binding ships with the server.

envVars.name: CANVAS_TEMP_PATH
envVars.description: Parent directory for DuckDB canvas spill files: a private 'mcp-canvas-XXXXXX' directory is created inside it, so it must be writable by the server process. Defaults to the OS temp directory.

envVars.name: CANVAS_TTL_MS
envVars.description: Sliding lifetime of a staged dataframe canvas in milliseconds; every call against it extends the window. Defaults to 24 hours.

envVars.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT
envVars.description: Maximum complete rows a single eurostat_dataframe_query returns before reporting truncated.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to list eurostat_dataframe_drop, which removes one staged table from a dataframe canvas and leaves its other tables in place. Off by default because a drop cannot be undone; staged tables expire with their canvas either way. Has no effect with CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=none.

envVars.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_WRITES
envVars.description: Register the mutating tools. Off by default, and the gate decides whether the write tools exist at all rather than merely refusing — an agent with writes off cannot see them.

envVars.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_CODES
envVars.description: Return one-time codes: a one-time-code field in apple_safari_page_elements, and apple_safari_find_codes for a code a page shows as text. Its own gate rather than allowWrites, because it is a read. Credential fields stay redacted whatever this says.

envVars.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_NETWORK
envVars.description: Register apple_safari_network_record, _list and _get, which record what a page you allowed the extension on fetches and read the responses. Its own gate rather than allowWrites, because it is a read; off means the tools do not exist. Headers named like credentials are masked, bodies are not. Reloading a tab to record and saving a body to a file still need APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_WRITES.

envVars.name: APPLE_SAFARI_DOWNLOAD_DIR
envVars.description: Where apple_safari_network_get's saveAs writes a file. Defaults to ~/Downloads. A name is kept to its basename and an existing file is never replaced unless asked.

envVars.name: APPLE_SAFARI_NETWORK_CHUNK_CHARS
envVars.description: Characters of a body the server asks the page for per command when it reads a large body. Defaults to 262144, which was measured to work; how far above that Safari's native-message channel goes is unmeasured.

envVars.name: KUBECONFIG
envVars.description: Path to kubeconfig file; defaults to ~/.kube/config if unset.

envVars.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default) or 'http'. The published package metadata still targets stdio by default.

envVars.name: MCP_MODE
envVars.description: Server mode: 'code' (default), compatibility alias 'all', or direct 'tools'.

envVars.name: MCP_CODE_MODE_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated configurable denials inside run_code. Environment overrides JSON; an empty value enables all configurable capabilities.

envVars.name: MCP_ARGO_TOOLS
envVars.description: Argo Workflows capability override: auto, on, or off. Auto uses Kubernetes API discovery.

envVars.name: MCP_ARGOCD_TOOLS
envVars.description: Argo CD capability override: auto, on, or off. Auto uses Kubernetes API discovery or explicit remote configuration.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging level: 'error', 'warn', 'info' (default), or 'debug'.

envVars.name: MCP_KUBE_CONTEXT
envVars.description: Kubernetes context name to use. If unset, uses the current context from kubeconfig.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY
envVars.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for Kubernetes API (use 'true' or '1'). Not recommended for production.

envVars.name: MCP_HIDE_SENSITIVE
envVars.description: Enable global sensitive data masking. Set to 'true' or '1' to mask sensitive values in responses.

envVars.name: MCP_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for operations. If unset, uses plugin-specific defaults.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: HTTP bind host when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: HTTP port when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 3000.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PATH
envVars.description: HTTP endpoint path when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to /mcp.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_JSON_RESPONSE
envVars.description: Prefer JSON responses over SSE in HTTP mode. Set to 'true' or '1' to enable.

envVars.name: MCP_APPROVAL_STATE_SECRET
envVars.description: Shared secret of at least 32 bytes for signing approval state. Required in HTTP mode and identical across replicas.

envVars.name: MCP_APPROVAL_REPLAY_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute directory on writable storage shared by every HTTP replica, used to atomically prevent approval replay.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Host allowlist for HTTP mode. Required when binding to 0.0.0.0 or ::.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for HTTP mode.

envVars.name: KUBE_MCP_FORCE_VM_SANDBOX
envVars.description: Force the standalone code-mode runtime to use node:vm instead of isolated-vm. Set to '1' to enable.

name: io.github.navapbc/rebar
description: Event-sourced ticket tracker + Jira reconciler, exposed as a Python library, CLI, and MCP server.

envVars.name: REBAR_ROOT
envVars.description: Path to the repo root that holds the .tickets-tracker store (defaults to the git toplevel of the working dir).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_READONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read tools (no write/mutation tools).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM
envVars.description: Set to 1 to enable the billable LLM tools (review_code / scan_spec / verify_completion / review_plan); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_JIRA_SYNC
envVars.description: Set to 1 to allow the live (mutating) Jira reconcile mode; otherwise reconcile is dry-run only.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport for the MCP server: 'stdio' (default) or 'http' (the optional Streamable-HTTP transport).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Bind host for the Streamable-HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Bind port for the Streamable-HTTP transport (1-65535; default 8000).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_PATH
envVars.description: URL path the Streamable-HTTP transport serves on (default /mcp).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of exact host:port values accepted by the Streamable-HTTP DNS-rebinding protection; empty defaults to loopback.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of exact Origin values accepted by the Streamable-HTTP DNS-rebinding protection; empty defaults to loopback.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_TLS_AT_EDGE
envVars.description: Set to 1 to acknowledge TLS is terminated at the edge; required to bind the Streamable-HTTP transport to a non-loopback host.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_HTTP
envVars.description: Set to 1 to acknowledge running the Streamable-HTTP transport without a token verifier; required to boot the HTTP transport while auth is off.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED
envVars.description: Set to 1 to enable MCP authentication (the composite token verifier + Resource-Server wiring); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STRATEGIES
envVars.description: Comma-separated, ordered list of token-verifier strategies to compose (closed set: static, jwt, introspection, proxy, custom).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL
envVars.description: OAuth authorization-server issuer URL advertised in the Protected-Resource Metadata (RFC 9728) when auth is enabled.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_RESOURCE_SERVER_URL
envVars.description: The single resource identifier (RFC 8707 audience) for this server; the composite verifier re-checks every accepted token against it.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED_SCOPES
envVars.description: Comma-separated scopes a caller must hold; the SDK returns 403 insufficient_scope when a principal lacks one.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STATIC_TOKENS_FILE
envVars.description: Path to the JSON secrets file for the static-bearer verifier (stores only SHA-256 digests of the accepted tokens).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI
envVars.description: HTTPS JWKS endpoint the `jwt` verifier fetches signing keys from (an OIDC provider's .well-known/jwks.json).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: Expected `iss` claim for the `jwt` verifier; falls back to REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL when unset.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALGORITHMS
envVars.description: Comma-separated PINNED, asymmetric-only JWS algorithms for the `jwt` verifier (default RS256,ES256); a symmetric algorithm on a JWKS source is refused.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_LEEWAY
envVars.description: Clock-skew leeway in seconds applied to exp/nbf validation by the `jwt` verifier (default 60).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_REFETCH_COOLDOWN
envVars.description: Minimum seconds between JWKS refetches triggered by an unknown key id (the concurrency-safe flood guard; default 30).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for the `jwt` verifier's JWKS fetch (default 10).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_EXPECTED_TYP
envVars.description: When set, the `jwt` verifier requires the JWT header `typ` to equal this (e.g. at+JWT per RFC 9068); unset skips the check.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_JWKS_HOST
envVars.description: Set to 1 to permit a private/link-local/loopback JWKS host (SSRF guard is on by default); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: The `introspection` verifier's RFC 7662 endpoint URL (must be https://); the opaque token is POSTed here on every request (no caching).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: The client id the `introspection` verifier presents to the Authorization Server via HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV
envVars.description: The NAME of the env var holding the introspection client secret (never the secret itself); must be present + non-empty at startup or the server refuses to start (fail-closed).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOST
envVars.description: Set to 1 to permit a private/link-local/loopback introspection endpoint host (SSRF guard is on by default); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ALLOW_MISSING_AUD
envVars.description: Set to 1 to accept an active introspection response that OMITS `aud` (many AS do); off by default (fail-closed reject).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SECRET_ENV
envVars.description: The NAME of the env var holding the trusted-proxy shared secret (never the secret itself); must be present + non-empty at startup or the `proxy` verifier refuses to start (fail-closed).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SECRET_HEADER
envVars.description: The header the fronting proxy sends its shared secret on; the identity is trusted only when this matches (constant-time; default x-proxy-auth).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_IDENTITY_HEADER
envVars.description: The header carrying the proxy-authenticated principal identity, trusted only when the secret header validates (default x-forwarded-user).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SCOPES
envVars.description: Comma-separated fixed scope set granted to proxy-authenticated principals; empty by default (the principal holds no scopes).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_CUSTOM_IMPORT
envVars.description: The `custom` strategy's `module:factory` import string, resolving to a factory that returns a TokenVerifier; a TRUSTED operator config value that loads and executes the operator-configured code at startup (fail-closed on any load error).

envVars.name: WEBULL_APP_KEY

envVars.description: Webull OpenAPI app secret. Signs every request; the app key alone cannot authenticate.

envVars.name: WEBULL_REGION_ID
envVars.description: Webull region: us, hk, jp, sg, th, my, uk, au, eu, br, mx, za.

envVars.name: WEBULL_ENVIRONMENT
envVars.description: prod trades the real account. paper repoints the ENTIRE client at Webull's sandbox, quotes included, and needs separate sandbox credentials — production keys return 401 there.

envVars.name: FINANCE_BROKER
envVars.description: Which broker adapter the account and order tools use, and where prices come from: webull, saxo or ibkr. Only the tools the configured broker can serve are registered, so the tool list never advertises one that would refuse. Webull is the only adapter that has been run against a live account; saxo and ibkr are written from published documentation and say so in every result they produce.

envVars.name: SAXO_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Only for FINANCE_BROKER=saxo. A 24-hour simulation token comes from Saxo's Developer Portal with no approval process and no live money; live access needs the OAuth2 code flow. UNVERIFIED ADAPTER.

envVars.name: SAXO_ENVIRONMENT
envVars.description: sim or live. Selects Saxo's simulation gateway or the live one.

envVars.name: IBKR_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Only for FINANCE_BROKER=ibkr. This is the Client Portal Web API, not the TWS socket API: run IBKR's Client Portal Gateway and log in at https://localhost:5000 in a browser first. A paper account works and is the better choice. UNVERIFIED ADAPTER.

envVars.name: IBKR_TLS_INSECURE
envVars.description: Set to 1 to accept the Client Portal Gateway's self-signed certificate unverified, or point IBKR_CACERT at it instead. This is a decision about the connection carrying your orders, so it is never made for you.

envVars.name: SEC_USER_AGENT
envVars.description: A descriptive User-Agent with a real contact address, e.g. 'Jane Doe (jane@example.com)'. The SEC's fair-access policy requires it and the filings tools refuse to send requests without one rather than risk an IP ban.

envVars.name: BLS_API_KEY
envVars.description: Optional. BLS allows 25 macro queries a day without a key; a free key raises it to 500 and extends history from 10 to 20 years.

envVars.description: Hosted mode: the API base (default https://hifriendbot.com/wp-json/agentwallet/v1); must be https, or http on localhost

envVars.description: Hosted mode: wallet id that pays hosted billing 402s automatically (POST /wallets, /sign, /send only); unset means never

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_DASHBOARD_URL
envVars.description: Hosted mode: dashboard link shown in tool text

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Local (self-custody) mode: 0x-prefixed EVM private key; signing then happens in this process

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_KEYFILE
envVars.description: Local mode: path of a file holding the EVM private key (instead of AGENTWALLET_PRIVATE_KEY; not both)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_SOLANA_KEY
envVars.description: Local mode for Solana: secret key as a JSON array, base58 or base64

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_SOLANA_KEYFILE
envVars.description: Local mode for Solana: path of a key file (instead of AGENTWALLET_SOLANA_KEY; not both)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_RPC_URL
envVars.description: Local mode: one EVM RPC for every chain

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_RPC_<chainId>
envVars.description: Local mode: EVM RPC per chain, e.g. AGENTWALLET_RPC_8453; eth_chainId is checked

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_SOLANA_RPC
envVars.description: Local mode: one Solana RPC for every cluster

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_SOLANA_RPC_<chainId>
envVars.description: Local mode: Solana RPC per cluster (900 mainnet, 901 devnet, 902 testnet); the genesis hash is checked

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_CHAIN_ID
envVars.description: Local mode: default EVM chain when a call names none (default 8453)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_TX_NATIVE
envVars.description: Local mode: per-transaction ceiling in native units

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_TX_TOKEN
envVars.description: Local mode: per-transaction ceiling for ERC-20 and SPL transfers and approvals, in token units

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_TX_SOL
envVars.description: Local mode: per-transaction ceiling in SOL (also charged for a recipient token account the send creates)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_ALLOW_UNKNOWN_TOKEN_CALLS
envVars.description: Local mode: 1 lets calldata the token cap cannot price reach a token contract (refused by default)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_ALLOW_UNLIMITED_APPROVAL
envVars.description: 1 lets an unlimited ERC-20 allowance or an NFT operator grant through while no spend policy is set (refused by default, and always refused under a policy)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_TOKEN_DECIMALS
envVars.description: Pin decimals for tokens outside the registry, e.g. 8453:0x<token>=6,<mint>=9; used for amounts and caps instead of the RPC answer

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_AUTOPAY
envVars.description: Per-payment x402 ceiling in stablecoin units (default 1); the agent cannot raise it

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_AUTOPAY_PER_HOUR
envVars.description: Hosted mode: how many internal 402 auto-payments an hour (default 20; 0 disables)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_AUTOPAY_ASSETS
envVars.description: Assets pay_x402 may pay in beyond registry stablecoins, e.g. 8453:native,0x<token>

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_X402_MAX_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Longest x402 authorization window in seconds (default 3600; 60 to 31536000)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_APPROVALS
envVars.description: Hosted mode: 0 disables emailing the wallet owner for an over-cap payment

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_PERMIT2_AUTO_APPROVE
envVars.description: Hosted mode: 1 approves exactly an upto payment maximum to Permit2 for registry stablecoins

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_TOKEN_RISK
envVars.description: 0 skips the GoPlus lookup approve_token performs

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_LEGACY_PAYWALL_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated https origins whose legacy-shaped 402 may be paid by an on-chain transfer proved by hash (the API host always may)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_MAX_FEE_NATIVE
envVars.description: Local mode: the most a transaction may burn in fees (gas x max fee per gas), in native units; default 0.01

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_POLICY
envVars.description: Path of a spend policy JSON file: rolling dollar and native budgets, host, recipient, chain, asset and tool lists, and a human-approval threshold, enforced from a hash-chained ledger

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_LEDGER
envVars.description: Path of the append-only ledger the policy is enforced from (default: agentwallet-ledger.jsonl beside the policy file)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_WEBHOOK_URL
envVars.description: https URL (or http on localhost) that receives every ledger line as it is written

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: HMAC-SHA256 key for the X-AgentWallet-Signature header on webhook posts

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_KEYFILE_PASSPHRASE
envVars.description: Passphrase that opens an encrypted keyfile (made with `agentwallet-mcp encrypt-keyfile`)

envVars.name: AGENTWALLET_KEYFILE_PASSPHRASE_FILE
envVars.description: Path of a file holding the keyfile passphrase (instead of AGENTWALLET_KEYFILE_PASSPHRASE; not both)

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_LABEL
envVars.description: Names this agent's tab ownership. Two agents with different labels never see each other's owned tabs. Defaults to "default".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_SPACE
envVars.description: With ARC_MCP_WINDOW=space, the Arc space new tabs open into, when a space with that name exists. Arc will not let a script create a space, so make it by hand. Defaults to "Agent".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_STATE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where per-session tab ownership is recorded, so a restarted agent can clean up the tabs its previous run left behind. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/arc-control-mcp.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_WINDOW
envVars.description: "dedicated" keeps agent tabs in one separate agent window, never the user's own. "space" puts them in the Agent space of the user's window. Defaults to "dedicated".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_WINDOW_PLACEMENT
envVars.description: Where the agent window goes once, at creation: "auto" (largest non-main display, else where Arc puts it), "second-display", "minimized" (experimental) or "none". Needs Accessibility. Defaults to "auto".

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_IDLE_MS
envVars.description: How many milliseconds the user must have been idle before the server does anything visible. 0 turns the activity gate off. Defaults to 1500.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_IDLE_WAIT_MS
envVars.description: How many milliseconds to wait for that pause before failing with userActive true. Defaults to 15000.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_ARC_DATA_DIR
envVars.description: Directory the local data tools (sidebar_tree, find_stale_tabs, search_archive, search_history) read Arc's files from. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/Arc.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_ALLOW_HISTORY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let search_history run. Off by default, and any other value leaves it off.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_CDP
envVars.description: Set to 0 to disable the DevTools engine (trusted input, screenshots, console and network capture). On by default, and inert until Arc is launched with --remote-debugging-port.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_CDP_PORT
envVars.description: The DevTools port to probe on 127.0.0.1. The host is fixed. Defaults to 9222.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Guardrail. Comma list of origins the agent may touch (host, *.host, scheme://host[:port], file://, about:). Anything not listed is refused. Unset means no allow list.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_BLOCKED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Guardrail. Comma list of origins the agent may not touch. Wins over the allow list. Unset means no block list.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_BLOCK_READS
envVars.description: Set to 1 to apply the origin lists to read tools as well as changing ones. Off by default.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read-only tools. Off by default.

envVars.name: ARC_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
envVars.description: Path of a file that gets one JSON line per changing call (time, tool, tab, origin, ok, error), never typed values or script code. Unset means no audit log.

Lossless by default — a denser encoding of the same bytes, with a round-trip gate asserting an exact inverse, so nothing is dropped or summarised. envVars.name: FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN
envVars.description: System-user access token (Business Manager). Takes precedence over FB_ACCESS_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_TOKEN when several are set.

envVars.name: FB_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Primary user access token. At least one of FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN, FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or FB_PAGE_TOKEN must be set.

envVars.name: FB_PAGE_TOKEN
envVars.description: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential when no user or system-user token is configured.

envVars.name: FB_APP_ID
envVars.description: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET it forms the app access token used to authorize /debug_token inspection.

envVars.name: FB_APP_SECRET
envVars.description: Meta app secret. When set, appsecret_proof is attached to every call so a stolen bare token cannot be used on its own.

envVars.name: FB_PAGE_ID
envVars.description: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile argument.

envVars.name: FB_API_VERSION
envVars.description: Graph API version to target. Defaults to the tested pinned version; other values are accepted verbatim as an escape hatch but are not tested.

envVars.name: FB_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds; integer in [1, 600000].

envVars.name: FB_HOST_CONCURRENCY
envVars.description: Maximum number of in-flight requests per Graph host; integer in [1, 64].

envVars.name: FB_MAX_RESULT_CHARS
envVars.description: Character budget applied by the result shaper before a tool result is truncated; integer in [500, 10000000].

envVars.name: FB_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, the default) or apply. It never covers the irreversible and spend tiers, which always need a per-call apply plus a plan_id.

envVars.name: FB_CONFIRM_TOKEN
envVars.description: Operator confirmation token for out-of-band approval of irreversible or spend actions. The server prompts through MCP elicitation where the client supports it; otherwise the caller passes this value as the confirm_token tool argument.

envVars.name: FB_MEDIA_DIR
envVars.description: Directory permitted for local media uploads. Unset means URL-only uploads and no local file access at all.

envVars.name: FB_JOURNAL_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the append-only write journal. Defaults to the XDG/%APPDATA% state path; the file is created owner-only (0600) and rotates by size.

envVars.name: FB_TOOL_PACKAGES
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool packages or profiles to expose (e.g. core,posts,reader, or the profiles core|all|reader|publisher|moderator|ads). Omit for the default profile, which excludes ads.

envVars.name: FB_PACKAGES_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated packages to exclude even when FB_TOOL_PACKAGES enables them. Deny wins over allow.

envVars.name: FB_PACKAGES_READONLY
envVars.description: Comma-separated packages whose write tools are not registered at all; the read tools of those packages stay available.

envVars.name: FB_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport protocol: stdio (default) or http. The http transport binds 127.0.0.1 only and fails closed without FB_HTTP_TOKEN.

envVars.name: FB_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token guarding the HTTP transport; required when FB_TRANSPORT=http (the server refuses to start without it).

envVars.name: FB_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Port for the HTTP transport (loopback only); used when FB_TRANSPORT=http. Integer in [1, 65535].

envVars.name: FB_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: Default ad account ID (act_… or the bare numeric id) for the opt-in ads package.

envVars.name: FB_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING
envVars.description: Hard ceiling for any ads budget write, in minor currency units (e.g. cents). Non-negative integer; a write above it is refused.

envVars.name: FB_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. Logs never go to stdout — that is the stdio protocol channel.

name: io.github.ObscuritySRL/umbriel
description: See and drive a whole Windows machine from Bun — apps, input, screen, OCR, registry, OS — via MCP.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_PROFILE
envVars.description: Capability profile: 'readonly' (inspect/read only), 'safe' (read + input + window — default), or 'full' (also os + fs tools).

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_OS
envVars.description: Set to '1' to allow the 'os' tools (launch_app/run_program/open_path, kill_process, manage_process, control_service, set_env, registry_get/registry_list/registry_set) AND the 'fs' tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) regardless of profile.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to additionally allow on top of the profile.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to deny, overriding the profile and UMBRIEL_ALLOW.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_CURSOR
envVars.description: Set to 'never' to forbid the real-cursor fallback entirely (strictly cursor-free). By default clicks/drags are cursor-free but fall back to the real hardware cursor when no cursor-free path exists.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_FS_ROOT
envVars.description: Sandbox root directory that the fs-category file tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) are confined to when fs tools are enabled; open_path's path argument is honored too.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_TRACE
envVars.description: File path to journal every mutating tool call as JSON Lines (tool, category, masked args, ok, observation); secret-bearing args and values are redacted. Unset = no trace.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_FFI_TRACE
envVars.description: File path to a flush-before-call diagnostic journal of every COM vcall (slot, this-pointer, arg count). Each line is written and flushed to the OS BEFORE the native call, so after an uncatchable crash the last line names the faulting call. Has per-call overhead; unset = off. For debugging native faults only.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_AUDIT
envVars.description: Controls the default-on stderr audit of mutating tool calls. 'off' is the explicit opt-out (reported at startup); 'verbose' also audits reads.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_REDACT
envVars.description: Credential masking (default on). 'off' opts out; a regex value overrides the built-in secret shapes masked in clipboard/env/registry reads and the trace journal.
