envVars.description: Ncloud region code. Public zone: KR, JPN, SGN, USWN, DEN. Government zone: KR (KR-CENTRAL), KRS (KR-SOUTH). Financial zone: FKR. Default KR (FKR in the Financial zone).

envVars.name: NCLOUD_TOOL_GROUPS
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool groups to load at startup, e.g. 'compute,network,billing' or 'all,-billing'. Unset = all groups. Include the 'dynamic' keyword to start with the core set (common+compute+network+database) AND allow mid-session expansion via the ncloud_enable_tool_group meta tool; without 'dynamic', the listed groups are locked (no runtime expansion). A '-'-excluded group is also refused for dynamic enable. common is always on.

envVars.name: NCLOUD_RESPONSE_PRUNE
envVars.description: Set to '1' to strip empty values (null/""/[]/{}) from responses globally.

envVars.name: NCLOUD_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: API request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000). HTTP 429 is always auto-retried up to 2 times; read-only query tools also retry 503/504 and network errors.

envVars.name: NCLOUD_LANG
envVars.description: Language for client error messages: 'en' for English, otherwise/unset is Korean (default).

envVars.name: NCLOUD_RESPONSE_MAXBYTES
envVars.description: Opt-in response-size guard for read-only tools. When set to a positive byte threshold, large read-only responses are truncated item-by-item to stay under it, adding 'truncated'/'suggestedPageSize' recovery hints. Unset/0 = guard off (response shape unchanged).

envVars.name: NOETIVE_KEY_SECRET
envVars.description: API key from the Noetive dashboard. Every tool reaches Noetive, so every tool needs it. Without it the server still starts and registers its tools, and each one explains what is missing.

envVars.name: NOETIVE_NAMESPACE
envVars.description: Namespace used when a tool call does not name one. There is no default; without this, every call must name a namespace.

envVars.name: NOETIVE_MODEL
envVars.description: Embedding model used when a tool call does not name one, for example Qwen3-Embedding-4B.

envVars.name: NOETIVE_DIMENSIONS
envVars.description: Embedding dimensionality used when a tool call does not name one, for example 1024. Must match the model.

envVars.name: NOETIVE_DISABLE_GLOBAL_NS
envVars.description: Set to 1 to close the shared "global" namespace on this server. Every call that routes there is refused before the request is sent, and the tools stop offering it as an example. Unset leaves it available. A value that is neither a yes nor a no stops the server rather than being read as no.

envVars.name: NOETIVE_EMBEDDINGS_URL
envVars.description: An OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint you run. Set it and embeddings are computed on this machine rather than by Noetive: a publish carries the vector alongside its text, and a query's anchor phrases are replaced by vectors so they are never sent. This is not confidential publishing: message text still travels, because that is what a search returns. The endpoint must answer to the same model name as NOETIVE_MODEL and return NOETIVE_DIMENSIONS values. Plain http is accepted only for a loopback address. Inside a container 127.0.0.1 is the container itself; use host.docker.internal.

envVars.name: NOETIVE_EMBEDDINGS_KEY_SECRET
envVars.description: Bearer token for that endpoint, when it needs one. Endpoints running on your own machine usually do not.

name: pdfnative MCP — PDF/A & PDF/X-4 generation, PAdES signing & introspection
description: PDF MCP: generate PDF/A & PDF/X-4, sign & verify PAdES (LTV), forms, merge, split, encrypt. 28 tools

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute path of a sandboxed directory where outputMode='file' may write PDFs. Unset: every tool returns base64 only (file output disabled).

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches encrypt/decrypt, sign, timestamp, add_ltv, update_metadata, encrypted builds or file output.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless). Unauthenticated unless PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Never logged.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES
envVars.description: Per-stream FlateDecode decompression cap in bytes (zip-bomb mitigation; default 104857600 = 100 MiB). Integer >= 1024; an invalid value refuses to start the server.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE
envVars.description: ISO 8601 instant with a time zone (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) pinned as the creation date of every generated document: reproducible bytes on any host. A call's own creationDate still wins. An invalid value refuses to start the server.

envVars.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
envVars.description: reproducible-builds.org convention: integer seconds since the Unix epoch, used as the pinned creation date when PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE is unset. An invalid value refuses to start the server.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL
envVars.description: http(s) URL of the RFC 3161 timestamp authority used by sign_pdf timestamp=true and timestamp_pdf (PAdES B-T / B-LTA). Unset: those calls fail with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED and no network request is made. Tool arguments can never supply a URL.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH
envVars.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the TSA (e.g. 'Basic ...' or 'Bearer ...'). Never logged or echoed.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION
envVars.description: 'ocsp', 'crl' or 'ocsp,crl': enables online revocation collection for add_ltv mode='online' (PAdES B-LT). Unset: that mode fails with REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED; mode='offline' stays fully offline. Requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allow-list of OCSP / CRL responder hosts ('host', 'host:port' or '*.suffix'). Mandatory when PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION is set: responder URLs found in certificates are fetched only if the host matches (http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal addresses rejected unless listed verbatim).

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout for TSA / OCSP / CRL calls in milliseconds, 1000-120000 (default 10000).

envVars.name: APP_TEMPLATE_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5/app-template checkout that scaffold_app serves and add_agent_setup executes. Default: ../app-template, else the GitHub mirror.

envVars.name: DOCS_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5/docs checkout that docs_search reads. Default: ../docs, else the GitHub mirror.

envVars.description: abap2UI5-addons/abap-cloud-gui checkout (with npm ci done) whose report2cloud converter migrate_report runs. Default: ../abap-cloud-gui; no mirror.

envVars.name: POPUPS_HOME
envVars.description: abap2UI5-addons/popups checkout whose popups migrate_report with deploy: true writes into the dev sandbox beside the converted class. Default: .deps/popups of the abap-cloud-gui checkout, ../popups beside it, then its build/popups.

envVars.name: OPENUI5_SRC
envVars.description: OpenUI5 source checkout scope_of reads the JSDoc from (via samples-controls). Default: ../fork-openui5 next to samples-controls.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_WORKSPACE
envVars.description: Where the npm backend installs, the dev sandbox lives and a framework clone lands. Default: ~/.abap2ui5-mcp.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_BACKEND
envVars.description: Which backend runs the apps: npm (the @abap2ui5/node-runtime package, even beside a checkout) or clone (clone the framework). Default: decided per call.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_RUNTIME_VERSION
envVars.description: Pin the @abap2ui5/node-runtime release (X.Y.Z) the npm backend installs. Default: the registry's latest.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Port of the local backend run_app boots against. Default: 3000.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_UI
envVars.description: Whether app_start/app_describe/app_act declare their MCP Apps screen (ui://abap2ui5/app-screen): auto (default - when the client advertises the io.modelcontextprotocol/ui extension), on, off.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_APP_FORMAT
envVars.description: The default answer format of the app tools: snapshot (default) or adaptive-card (the snapshot plus an Adaptive Card 1.5 as an embedded resource, for card-rendering hosts).

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_OFFLINE
envVars.description: Set to 1 for no network: no UI5 CDN fallback, no GitHub mirror, no registry lookup.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE
envVars.description: Set to 0 to switch off the read-only GitHub mirror used when no checkout is found.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE_DIR
envVars.description: Cache directory of the GitHub mirror. Default: <tmp>/abap2ui5-mcp-remote.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: How long a mirrored copy is used before it is refreshed, in milliseconds. Default: one day.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_UI5_CACHE_MB
envVars.description: How many MB of UI5 answers from the CDN (sdk.openui5.org) run_app and interact_app keep in memory across calls, so a second boot does not download them again. 0 switches the cache off. Default: 64.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_RENDER_PAGES
envVars.description: Pages (Chromium tabs) of validate_view's warm render gate, which concurrent calls queue on. Default: 2 (1 to 8).

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_CHROMIUM
envVars.description: Chromium binary for run_app and interact_app. Default: CHROMIUM_BIN, Playwright's managed browser, then a system chromium.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SCREENSHOT_DIR
envVars.description: Where run_app and interact_app write their PNGs (the newest 50 are kept) and build_backend its log. Default: <tmp>/abap2ui5-mcp-screenshots.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_PREBUILT_URL
envVars.description: Where build_backend mode prebuilt downloads the backend from. Default: the framework's release asset.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_WORKER
envVars.description: Set to 0 to run every lint as a fresh abaplint process. Default: a long-lived worker keeps @abaplint/core with the framework parsed and lints a deploy in milliseconds (the CLI runs whenever the worker cannot stand in for it).

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_IDLE_MS
envVars.description: How long the warm lint worker (about 300 MB with the framework parsed) is kept without a request before it exits, in milliseconds; the next lint starts a fresh one. 0 keeps it for the server's life. Default: 10 minutes.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Hard timeout of the abaplint run, in milliseconds. Default: 5 minutes.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SCOPE_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Hard timeout of scope_of, in milliseconds. Default: 5 minutes.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Hard timeout of a build, the prebuilt download and the npm install, in milliseconds. Default: 30 minutes.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_UNIT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Hard timeout of the ABAP Unit runner, in milliseconds. Default: 10 minutes.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_URL
envVars.description: Switches on the SYSTEM MODE: the app tools against this real SAP system instead of the sandbox loop. The launch URL, e.g. https://host:44300/sap/bc/z2ui5?app_start={class}&sap-client=100.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_USER
envVars.description: System mode: the SAP user the app tools log on with (Basic authentication).

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD
envVars.description: System mode: the password of A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_USER. Or A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD_CMD, to keep it out of the configuration.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD_CMD
envVars.description: System mode: a shell command that prints the password (a keychain lookup) - instead of A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD.

envVars.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_INSECURE_TLS
envVars.description: System mode: set to 1 to accept a certificate that cannot be verified. NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS with the CA is the better fix.

envVars.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional token sent to api.github.com only, to raise the rate limit of the docs tree listing (GH_TOKEN is read too).

name: Cost Guard MCP
description: Pre-flight query cost and result-size guardrails for AI agents on BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks

envVars.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
envVars.description: BigQuery: path to a service-account key file (Application Default Credentials). Required to use the bigquery engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT
envVars.description: Snowflake: account identifier. Required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_USER
envVars.description: Snowflake: username. Required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_ROLE
envVars.description: Snowflake: role to assume. Required to use the snowflake engine; has no default and must never be ACCOUNTADMIN (ACCOUNTADMIN, SECURITYADMIN and ORGADMIN are rejected before any Snowflake connection is opened - the check runs when the Snowflake configuration is first loaded, on the first Snowflake tool call; the server process itself starts regardless, so a bad role surfaces as a failed check_credentials or a tool error, not as a startup exit).

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_SECONDARY_ROLES
envVars.description: Snowflake: secondary roles activated at login. NONE (default) means only SNOWFLAKE_ROLE is active in the session; ALL is the explicit opt-out that activates every role granted to SNOWFLAKE_USER.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Snowflake: path to an RSA private key file for key-pair auth (preferred over SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD). Either this or SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD is required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSPHRASE
envVars.description: Snowflake: passphrase for an encrypted SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH key file, if the key is encrypted.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Snowflake: password (discouraged; prefer SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH). Either this or SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH is required to use the snowflake engine.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_EDITION
envVars.description: Snowflake: account edition that sets the USD/credit price of estimates - standard (default), enterprise, business_critical or vps. The per-call edition argument can only raise it.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_SERVER_HOSTNAME
envVars.description: Databricks: SQL warehouse server hostname (e.g. my-workspace.cloud.databricks.com, no scheme, no trailing slash). Required to use the databricks engine.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH
envVars.description: Databricks: SQL warehouse HTTP path (from the warehouse's Connection Details tab, e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/<warehouse-id>). Required to use the databricks engine.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Databricks: personal access token (simplest auth option). Either this or DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID + DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET is required to use the databricks engine.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Databricks: OAuth machine-to-machine service-principal client ID (preferred for automated use). Requires DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET as well.

envVars.name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Databricks: OAuth machine-to-machine service-principal client secret. Requires DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID as well.

envVars.name: COST_GUARD_ALLOW_MULTI_STATEMENT_SQL
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let estimate_query_cost/run_query_bounded accept text containing more than one SQL statement. Off by default: the cost cap is only known to cover the single statement the dry run/EXPLAIN priced. Skips only this server's scanner: Snowflake still rejects multi-statement text (sessions are pinned to MULTI_STATEMENT_COUNT=1), and only a single SELECT/WITH/VALUES statement is wrapped in a LIMIT subquery - a script runs unwrapped and its row cap (max_rows, default 1000) is enforced by the paged fetch.

envVars.name: COST_GUARD_ALLOW_WRITE_STATEMENTS
envVars.description: Set to 1 (exactly that value) to let estimate_query_cost/run_query_bounded accept statements that are not reads. Off by default: only text whose first keyword (after comments and opening parentheses) is SELECT, WITH, VALUES, SHOW, DESCRIBE, DESC or EXPLAIN is estimated or run - a WITH must be followed by a SELECT or VALUES - because warehouse rows re-enter the model's context and can steer the next call. The gate is defence in depth: the authorisation boundary is the credential's grants (deploy a read-only principal). With COST_GUARD_ALLOW_MULTI_STATEMENT_SQL=1 every statement in the text must be a read, so BigQuery scripts (DECLARE/SET/BEGIN) need both opt-outs. Any other value leaves the gate on.

envVars.name: COST_GUARD_MAX_IN_FLIGHT_QUERIES
envVars.description: Maximum number of run_query_bounded calls allowed in flight at once (positive integer, default 8). A cancelled call keeps its slot until its warehouse query completes or the 120 s watchdog fires; a call over the cap fails with a tool error naming this variable before any warehouse connection is opened.

envVars.name: COST_GUARD_DATABRICKS_ALLOW_WAREHOUSE_START
envVars.description: Set to true (exactly that value) to let the read-only Databricks tools (check_credentials, estimate_query_cost) open a session on a SQL warehouse that is not RUNNING, which starts the warehouse and bills compute until it auto-stops. Off by default: the server first reads the warehouse's state through the Warehouses API (GET /api/2.0/sql/warehouses/<id>, CAN_VIEW/CAN_USE suffices) and, unless it is RUNNING - also when the state cannot be read - check_credentials returns ok=false and estimate_query_cost returns no byte or dollar figure, without opening a session. run_query_bounded is not gated: its own pre-execution estimate and the execution may start the warehouse. Any other value leaves the guard on.

envVars.name: COST_GUARD_SNOWFLAKE_ALLOW_WAREHOUSE_RESUME
envVars.description: Set to true (exactly that value) to let the read-only Snowflake tools run SELECT CURRENT_REGION(), the INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY read and check_credentials' session-context SELECT on a warehouse that is not STARTED, which can resume a suspended AUTO_RESUME warehouse and bill compute until it auto-suspends. Off by default: those statements are skipped unless the pinned warehouse's SHOW WAREHOUSES state is STARTED (also skipped when no warehouse is pinned or the state cannot be read), and the QUERY_HISTORY read is skipped whenever estimate_query_cost is called without a warehouse argument; estimate_query_cost then prices at Gen1 rates with the byte-tier heuristic and says so in a caveat, and check_credentials returns ok=true with a detail built from the SHOW WAREHOUSES row. USE WAREHOUSE, EXPLAIN USING JSON, SHOW WAREHOUSES and SELECT CURRENT_WAREHOUSE() always run; run_query_bounded is not gated. Any other value leaves the guard on.

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_TOPOLOGY

envVars.description: Port of the operator listener; required when DATAPRISM_OPERATOR_ENABLED=true, must differ from the server, management (OPERATOR_PORT_SHARED otherwise) and member ports, and has no fixed default (publish it explicitly)

name: edycutjong/BagOS
description: Bags on Solana: token analytics, creator-fee data and trade quotes, plus gated swaps and fee claims. A write's first call signs nothing: it returns a preview and a single-use confirmation token bound to the exact arguments. Every transaction is then simulated and refused if it would take more SOL than was approved (default cap 0.1 SOL per trade). 100% test coverage enforced in CI, published with npm provenance. `npx -y bagos-mcp-server`

envVars.name: BAGS_API_KEY
envVars.description: Bags API key from dev.bags.fm. Required for all tools.

envVars.name: BAGS_NETWORK
envVars.description: Solana cluster: devnet (default) or mainnet. Writes on mainnet move real funds.

envVars.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
envVars.description: Custom Solana RPC endpoint. Defaults to the public RPC for BAGS_NETWORK.

envVars.name: BAGS_KEYPAIR_PATH
envVars.description: Path to a Solana keypair JSON file. Only required for write tools.

envVars.name: BAGS_MAX_SOL_PER_TX
envVars.description: Hard cap on SOL spent by any single transaction. Default 0.1.

envVars.name: BAGS_MAX_SOL_PER_SESSION
envVars.description: Hard cap on total SOL spent across one server session. Default 1.0.

envVars.name: BAGS_ALLOW_UNCONFIRMED
envVars.description: Set true to skip the two-step confirmation on writes. Default false.

envVars.name: BOS_TOKEN_MINT
envVars.description: Mint address of the BOS token used for gating write tools.

envVars.name: BOS_REQUIRED_BALANCE
envVars.description: Minimum BOS balance required to call write tools. Default 10000.

envVars.name: BAGS_ALLOW_UNCAPPED_TOKEN_SWAPS
envVars.description: Permit non-SOL-input swaps, which the SOL-denominated caps cannot limit.

envVars.description: Maximum accepted input image size in bytes.

envVars.description: HTTP timeout in seconds when fetching remote image URLs (fetch_image and URL inputs).

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S
envVars.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S
envVars.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S
envVars.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES

envVars.name: CK_COOKIES
envVars.description: Optional. The full Cookie header from a signed-in creditkarma.com request. Leave unset to use the browser fallback — install ContextMint Bridge (https://github.com/nullnet-app/contextmint-bridge/releases), sign into creditkarma.com, and the MCP reads cookies automatically. Otherwise copy the header from DevTools → Network → any creditkarma.com request → Request Headers.

envVars.name: CK_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to skip the ContextMint Bridge browser-extension fallback (missing creds become a hard error — useful in headless CI).

envVars.name: CK_DEBUG
envVars.description: Set to 1 to trace auth to stderr: credential source, cookie names, token issue/expiry times, and the token-refresh exchange. Never logs token or cookie values.

envVars.name: CK_DB_PATH
envVars.description: Path to SQLite database file (default ~/.creditkarma-mcp/transactions.db).

envVars.name: CK_SESSION_PATH
envVars.description: Saved-session file that ck_set_session and token refreshes write (default ~/.creditkarma-mcp/session).

envVars.name: CK_CREDIT_BUREAU
envVars.description: Credit report used for card and loan balances: transunion or equifax (default transunion).

envVars.name: CK_SYNC_MAX_PAGES
envVars.description: Pages one ck_sync_transactions call may fetch before pausing. Unset (or unparseable) = unbounded, which is what a local stdio server wants. Set it on a hosted deployment, where the call has to answer inside the client's request timeout.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
envVars.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
envVars.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

envVars.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
envVars.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` (with a warning) on a host where that directory is not usable.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_SERVER_NAME
envVars.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION
envVars.description: Concise routing context that distinguishes this deployment's material or responsibility.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA
envVars.description: Deployment-specific behavioral policy added to the generated MCP instructions.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
envVars.description: Legacy: replaces all generated MCP instructions (deprecated; use _INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION for routing and _INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA for policy).

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level for every logger in the process, FastMCP's included (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG. The unprefixed FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL still works for one major version and logs a deprecation warning.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_LOG_FORMAT
envVars.description: Log rendering. rich is one colour event key=value line per record, for a terminal; json is one JSON object per record, for a collector. Unset picks rich when stderr is a terminal and json everywhere else, so a container or journald gets JSON with no configuration.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_PAPERLESS_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of the Paperless-NGX REST API, without a trailing slash. The server refuses to start without it.

envVars.description: Paperless service-account token used for outbound API requests. The server refuses to start without it.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
envVars.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in seconds.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_HTTP_RETRIES
envVars.description: Retries for idempotent requests after network errors or 5xx responses.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
envVars.description: Default page size for list tools, from 1 through 100.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_PAPERLESS_PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Public Paperless UI URL for user-visible links; defaults to PAPERLESS_URL.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S
envVars.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S
envVars.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S
envVars.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.

envVars.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

name: SAIHM-Admin/saihm-mcp-server-pro
description: Client-side encrypted agent memory where the server only sees ciphertext, with post-quantum identity and sharing and crypto-shredding for GDPR erasure.

envVars.name: SAIHM_ENDPOINT_URL
envVars.description: SAIHM operator endpoint. Optional: defaults to the hosted service at https://saihm.net/mcp.

envVars.name: SAIHM_SELF_JOIN
envVars.description: Self-join is ON by default: the saihm_join tool creates a non-custodial identity on this device and starts activating its free memory, which needs one browser sign-in; no master secret is needed. Set to '0' to suppress the tool.

envVars.name: SAIHM_MASTER_SECRET_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a mode-600 file holding a 64+ hex-char master secret. Only needed if you opt out of self-join, are restoring an existing identity, or keep your key file outside SAIHM_HOME. Never transmitted.

envVars.name: SAIHM_IDENTITY
envVars.description: An identity token written by export-identity: brings an existing SAIHM identity to this machine or a hosted agent environment without copying a key file. Set together with SAIHM_IDENTITY_PASSPHRASE; leave both unset to use this machine's own identity.

envVars.name: SAIHM_IDENTITY_PASSPHRASE
envVars.description: The passphrase export-identity generated for SAIHM_IDENTITY. The two together are the identity: store it as a secret.

envVars.name: SAIHM_TIER
envVars.description: The plan this identity onboards with (FREE, PRO, PRO_FAST, ENTERPRISE, ENTERPRISE_FAST). Defaults to FREE while self-join is on (the default); set it for a paid plan, and with SAIHM_SELF_JOIN=0 for every plan, FREE included. An export-identity token carries its own, which a non-empty value here overrides.

envVars.name: SAIHM_PAYMENT_METHOD
envVars.description: The payment rail of a paid plan, e.g. stripe. Required for a paid SAIHM_TIER unless an export-identity token carries it.

envVars.name: SAIHM_EPHEMERAL_HOME
envVars.description: Set it (e.g. 1) where the home directory is discarded at session end, or is a CI runner's home that later jobs can reach: the join then refuses to create a key, and SAIHM keeps no recall copy and no sign-in there. A copy or sign-in already written there stays until you delete it: the recall.* and session.* files in SAIHM_HOME (~/.saihm by default). 0 declares a home that is kept and that only you use, and overrides the host's own signal. Unset: detected where the host or CI runner says so (the REFERENCE lists the markers).

envVars.name: SAIHM_HOME
envVars.description: Base dir for the self-join identity file ($SAIHM_HOME/free-identity.key, mode 600). Defaults to ~/.saihm. Give a full path: a relative one (a JSON config does not expand ~) is refused at start. Also the fallback state directory when SAIHM_STATE_DIR is unset.

envVars.description: Origin URL for routes the edge defers with a use_origin answer (for example the free conformance checker). Optional; without it such a tool reports which variable to set.

envVars.name: AUTOMATON_MCP_PAYER_KEY
envVars.description: Private key of the wallet that pays for calls. The server only SIGNS an EIP-3009 authorisation; it never sends a transaction. Also required: ALLOW_OUTBOUND_SPEND=1, and this key is not loaded into the process without it. Never set this to the payee/treasury wallet: that is rejected.

envVars.name: ALLOW_OUTBOUND_SPEND
envVars.description: Set to 1 to permit this server to sign paid calls. Any other value (including absent) leaves every paid tool answering with the price only.

envVars.name: AUTOMATON_MCP_MAX_AMOUNT_UNITS
envVars.description: Per-call ceiling in USDC base units (6 decimals, so 10000 = 0.01 USDC). A requirement above it is refused before signing.

envVars.name: AUTOMATON_MCP_TOTAL_CAP_UNITS
envVars.description: Ceiling for the whole process lifetime, in USDC base units. Stops a runaway loop, not just a single expensive call.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: When set, serve Streamable HTTP on this port instead of stdio. Binds to 127.0.0.1 by default.

envVars.description: Cap on running background jobs: decimal integer 1 to 8 (default 8). Blocking calls do not use this cap.

envVars.description: Opt-in local usage log: on or off (default off). Records counts and settings, never prompts, code or paths; labels are caller text.

envVars.description: Reasoning effort used when a call specifies none: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. Unset: the model's own default. Cannot exceed CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_EFFORT.

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_ALLOWED_MODELS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allow-list of model slugs; anything else is refused. Unset: unrestricted. A single entry acts as the default model; an empty entry is a configuration error.

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_SANDBOX
envVars.description: Sandbox used when a call specifies none: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access. Defaults to read-only and cannot exceed the ceiling.

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_SANDBOX
envVars.description: Ceiling on what a delegation may do: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access. Defaults to workspace-write; danger-full-access must be set explicitly.

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_EFFORT
envVars.description: Ceiling on reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. Unset: unrestricted. Higher efforts are lowered to a supported level, or refused if none fits.

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MCP_SERVERS
envVars.description: MCP servers from Codex's config a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated names.

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_PLUGINS
envVars.description: Installed Codex plugins a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated name@marketplace ids.

envVars.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_APPS
envVars.description: Whether a delegation keeps Codex's apps (connectors to external services): off (default) or on.

envVars.name: CODEX_BIN
envVars.description: Codex executable name or path. Unset: codex, searched on PATH. On Windows it must run directly, such as codex.exe; a .cmd or .bat shim is refused.

envVars.description: BAM service-account password. Required alongside BAM_USERNAME, unless the SSO pair is used instead.

envVars.name: BAM_SSO_USERNAME
envVars.description: BAM SSO username. Alternative to BAM_USERNAME + BAM_PASSWORD; the server needs exactly one of the two pairs.

envVars.name: BAM_SSO_PASSWORD
envVars.description: BAM SSO password. Required alongside BAM_SSO_USERNAME when using the SSO pair.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
envVars.description: Client authentication mode for the /mcp endpoint. One of: none | static-key | signed-key | resource-server. Required at runtime — the server refuses to start without it (no default).

envVars.name: MCP_API_KEY
envVars.description: Static bearer token clients present as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Required only when MCP_AUTH_MODE=static-key.

envVars.name: MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY
envVars.description: HMAC key (at least 32 bytes) sealing the approval-gated write tools' requestState on MCP 2026-07-28 connections (#1031). Optional: unset uses a random per-process key, which is fine for a single replica; set the same value on every replica of a multi-replica deployment.

envVars.name: MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY_PREVIOUS
envVars.description: Second requestState HMAC key, accepted for opening a sealed plan but never for sealing one: two-key rotation of MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY (#1032). Optional, and only valid together with MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY. When rolling the key across replicas set this to the old key, and remove it two minutes after the last replica restarted.

envVars.name: MCP_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY
envVars.description: Ed25519 public key (base64url) that MCP_AUTH_MODE=signed-key verifies license tokens against. DEFAULTS TO A SHARED DEMO KEY, which authenticates a token holder rather than a customer — every BlueCat-issued token for this server verifies against it. For anything beyond a trial, generate a per-deployment key pair (license-keygen --gen-key) and set this to its public half.

envVars.name: MCP_SIGNED_KEY_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: When set, a license token must carry exactly this audience or it is rejected — a declarative scope check on top of the key, so a token minted for another deployment fails even if it verifies. Unset means the aud claim is not checked. Only meaningful with MCP_AUTH_MODE=signed-key.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER
envVars.description: Token issuer URL, matched against the iss claim of incoming JWTs. Required when MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server — the server refuses to start in that mode without it.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_JWKS_URI
envVars.description: JWKS endpoint whose public keys verify the signature on every incoming Bearer JWT. Required when MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server — the server refuses to start in that mode without it.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected JWT aud claim for MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server. A token carrying a different audience, or no aud claim at all, is rejected. Unset skips audience validation entirely.

envVars.name: ACCEPT_EULA
envVars.description: Set to Y (or Yes/YES, any casing) to accept the BlueCat End User License Agreement. The container refuses to start without it.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_API_KEY
envVars.description: Wontopos API key (wos-live-...). Create one in the console at wontopos.com.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_USER_ID
envVars.description: Default store for every tool call (default: "default").

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_MODEL
envVars.description: Engine to read with: tablet-2 (default — same token price as tablet-1, and the one that serves photos and re-ask), tablet-1, scroll-1, or scroll-1.2.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_VERIFY
envVars.description: Default re-ask passes for search, 0-3 (default 0). Each pass is another engine call and is billed for what it delivers; the agent can raise it per call.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_MAX_IMAGES
envVars.description: Default photo results per search, 0-5 (default 0). Zero because these rows ride on every search; the view_image tool fetches the one picture that is wanted.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_BASE_URL
envVars.description: A different API host. Leave unset for the default.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in ms (default 20000). A stalled API then fails in-band instead of hanging the host.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 for read-only mode: recall/search/list_memories/engram/stats/revisions/view_image/usage only, no write or delete tools.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_ALLOW_STORE_OVERRIDE
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store). Default: every call is pinned to WONTOPOS_USER_ID.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Serve over HTTP on this port instead of stdio, for hosts that cannot spawn a local process. Requires WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry. Required whenever WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT is set.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Interface to bind in HTTP mode. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only).

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Host header values to accept in HTTP mode, for a tunnel that forwards its own public name. Loopback and the bind address are always accepted; anything else is refused 403.

envVars.name: DATABASE_URL
envVars.description: Your own PostgreSQL, where this library keeps file ownership, grants and the audit chain. Apply node_modules/@filelayer/core/schema.sql once before starting.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_AS
envVars.description: The ONE subject this server speaks for, in your own id space. Fixed for the life of the process: no tool reads it as an argument and no tool can change it, which is the only reason exposing these tools to an agent is safe. Write it yourself or have your provisioning write it, never derive it from a conversation. Serving several people means starting several servers.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_ORG
envVars.description: The organisation this server is scoped to, in your own id space.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_DATA_DIR
envVars.description: A local directory for the bytes. Needs no bucket and no IAM user. Set this OR the S3_* block: with neither, the server refuses to start rather than falling back to memory, which would work in a demo and lose the first real file.

envVars.name: S3_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: An S3-compatible endpoint, for example https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Setting it makes S3_BUCKET, S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID and S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY required.

envVars.name: S3_BUCKET
envVars.description: The bucket. It must be private: this library decides who may be GIVEN a URL and has no say in who the object store will answer. `npx -p @filelayer/core filelayer doctor` reports whether yours serves unauthenticated reads.

envVars.name: S3_REGION
envVars.description: Region, or `auto` for Cloudflare R2.

envVars.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Access key id for the bucket.

envVars.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
envVars.description: Secret access key for the bucket.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_MCP_AGENT_LABEL
envVars.description: How this agent names itself in the audit trail, recorded on every event these tools produce. It is what lets the chain separate "the partner opened this document" from "the partner's assistant opened this document".

envVars.name: FILELAYER_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
envVars.description: Set to exactly `true` to register delete_file. Off by default because deleting is not recoverable and an agent that misreads a sentence deletes the wrong thing silently.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_MCP_EXPOSE_AUDIT
envVars.description: Set to exactly `true` to register file_audit. Off by default because the trail is an organisation's whole history and a tool that returns it copies every file name, actor and denial into the model's context. Reading it is itself audited since 0.27.0, which was the previous reason; the default did not move.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_MCP_RETURN_BYTES
envVars.description: Set to exactly `true` to register read_file. Off by default because a document returned by a tool is a document copied into a model's context; file_info plus a share link is usually what was actually needed.

envVars.name: FILELAYER_BASE_URL
envVars.description: The base of the share URLs this instance mints. Without it, share links come back without a URL.

envVars.description: Ed25519 seed, 64 hex characters, that signs this server's evidence-bundle receipts and checkpoint, so gateway_public_key (get_server_info) is the same after a restart and can be pinned. Set in your MCP client's configuration, the seed sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Receipts are kept in memory only; save a generate_evidence_bundle result before the server stops. Unset or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr. When set, even to an invalid value, AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE is not read.

envVars.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file holding the 64-hex Ed25519 seed; read only when AGA_GATEWAY_KEY is unset or empty, with the same effect. A stdio server started by your MCP client runs as the client's OS user, so the file sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Missing, unreadable or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr.

envVars.description: Your Apple Developer Team ID (10 characters). Needed for Apple Music (official API), Apple Maps and WeatherKit.

envVars.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Key ID of a private key created in Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Keys with Media Services (MusicKit), MapKit JS and/or WeatherKit enabled.

envVars.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Contents of that key's .p8 file (PEM; one-line values with \n escapes and base64 are accepted).

envVars.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Local installs only: a path to the .p8 file instead of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Music (pair with APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY).

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Music.

envVars.name: APPLE_MAPS_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Maps.

envVars.name: APPLE_MAPS_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Maps.

envVars.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for WeatherKit.

envVars.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for WeatherKit.

envVars.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_SERVICE_ID
envVars.description: WeatherKit only: the Services ID registered for WeatherKit (e.g. com.example.weather).

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional: a pre-minted Apple Music developer token (JWT) instead of signing one from the key above.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Music User Token for your library (official API), from a one-time MusicKit sign-in: `npx apple-icloud-mcp music-auth`. Without the Apple Developer key, ask the owner for a developer token (music-auth --print-developer-token) and run it with APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN set. Lasts ~6 months.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_USER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Opt-in web-player mode (no developer account needed; unlocks rename/delete/remove/reorder): the media-user-token cookie from a signed-in music.apple.com tab.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional override for the web-player developer token (normally read automatically from music.apple.com).

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_STOREFRONT
envVars.description: Two-letter Apple Music storefront (e.g. us, gb). Default: your account's storefront, else us.

envVars.name: ICLOUD_USERNAME
envVars.description: Your Apple ID email, for iCloud Calendar, Contacts and Mail.

envVars.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
envVars.description: An app-specific password from appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (NOT your Apple ID password).

envVars.name: ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS
envVars.description: Your @icloud.com address, only if your Apple ID email is not an iCloud address (needed for Mail).

envVars.name: ICLOUD_DEFAULT_CALENDAR
envVars.description: Calendar new events go to when none is named (default: the first writable event calendar).

envVars.name: APPLE_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: "none" = read-only tools; "additive" = also create/append, never modify, delete or send; "all" = everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

envVars.name: APPLE_SERVICES
envVars.description: Comma-separated services to enable (music, calendar, contacts, mail, maps, weather, itunes). Default: all.

envVars.name: DISPLAY_TZ
envVars.description: IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York) for displayed times and for dates you give without an offset. Set this on a hosted server, which runs in UTC.

envVars.name: APPLE_UNITS
envVars.description: "metric" (default) or "imperial" units for weather (Maps distances always show both).

envVars.name: APPLE_STATE_CACHE
envVars.description: Set to false to write nothing under $MCP_DATA_DIR/.apple-icloud-mcp: no web-player token or iCloud discovery cache, and the rejected-password latch and spent confirmation tokens then last only as long as the process.

envVars.name: APPLE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000).

envVars.name: APPLE_DEBUG_LOG
envVars.description: Set to 1 to log every upstream request line to stderr (credentials redacted).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_MODE
envVars.description: How confirm-gated writes (send mail, deletes, removing tracks, invitations) behave on a client with no prompt, like claude.ai: "ask-user" (default: preview + confirmToken, the model must get your OK), "auto", or "refuse". Unknown values mean refuse.

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_ELICITATION
envVars.description: "off" never shows a confirmation prompt, so every client gets the MCP_CONFIRM_MODE flow. Set it for a client that says it can prompt but never does (the gated call hangs, e.g. opencode 2.0.x). Any other value stays "on" (with a stderr warning).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS
envVars.description: Lifetime of a confirmToken in seconds (default 600).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_SECRET
envVars.description: Signing key for confirmTokens. Random per process by default; set it so a token issued just before a restart or redeploy still works (spent tokens are recorded on disk, so none can be replayed).

envVars.description: Selects which `~/.coa/config` profile to load. Defaults to default.

envVars.name: COALESCE_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Region-specific base URL. Defaults to https://app.coalescesoftware.io (US).

envVars.description: Fallback org ID for cancel-run. Also readable from `orgID` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

envVars.name: COALESCE_REPO_PATH
envVars.description: Local repo root for repo-backed tools and pipeline planning. Also readable from `repoPath` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

envVars.name: COALESCE_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory for the local data cache. When set, cache files are written here instead of the working directory. Also readable from `cacheDir` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_AUTO_CACHE_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: JSON size threshold before auto-caching to disk. Defaults to 32768.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_INLINE_RESPONSES
envVars.description: Forces large responses inline as text instead of auto-caching them to disk and returning a `resource_link` (and suppresses per-field cache resource links). The server already auto-enables this for clients known not to support MCP resources (e.g. Snowflake Cortex), which otherwise render the link as unreadable "binary data" and retry in a loop. Set `true` to force it on for an unrecognised client, or `false` to disable auto-detection. Leave unset for Claude/Cursor to keep large payloads out of context. Defaults to false (auto-enabled for resource-less clients).

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_LINEAGE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory lineage cache TTL in milliseconds. Defaults to 1800000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Max outbound API request body size. Defaults to 524288.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Default per-request timeout for Coalesce API calls. Raise on large workspaces where paginated reads exceed the default. Defaults to 60000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_DETAIL_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-page timeout for detail=true paginated fetches of large node lists. Defaults to 180000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_TYPE_RANKING_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Deadline for the best-effort workspace-adoption node-type ranking lookup inside node creation. Advisory only — creation proceeds without a ranking suggestion if this trips. Defaults to 15000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_INVENTORY_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-type inventory. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_INDEX_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-index (id/name/type/location) cache used by SQL- and intent-ref resolution. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_DETAIL_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-detail (full body) cache used by review and predecessor lookups. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: When `true`, hides all write/mutation tools during registration. Only read, list, search, cache, analyze, review, diagnose, and plan tools are exposed. Defaults to false.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_FILE_URL
envVars.description: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only). Private/internal addresses are rejected regardless (resolution-time check; see the documented DNS TOCTOU limitation in the hosted-deployment runbook).

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER
envVars.description: Escape hatch for MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true WITHOUT inbound-token introspection: set to "true" ONLY when an upstream gateway already verifies Bearer tokens. The server logs a prominent warning and forwards tokens upstream unverified.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Empty = Host validation disabled (default). When set, requests with a Host outside the list are rejected.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense). Empty = reject any request carrying an Origin header; non-browser clients (CLI/SDK) send no Origin and are always allowed. Use '*' to allow all.

envVars.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Upstream API root. Required: your user key is exchanged for a session token against this host, and the server will not start without it.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_USER_KEY
envVars.description: Long-lived EAD Enterprise Suite user key, exchanged automatically for a short-lived session token. Use it for headless or automated access instead of an account password. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC
envVars.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless (1) MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set AND (2) inbound Bearer introspection is configured (MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL + MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER=true is set explicitly (fail-closed).

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Client ID this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite.

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Client secret this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL
envVars.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in, and required when MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true. Leave empty for stdio (local) use.

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC
envVars.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless (1) MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set AND (2) inbound Bearer introspection is configured (MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL + MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER=true is set explicitly (fail-closed).

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: OAuth2 client_credentials client ID.

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: OAuth2 client_credentials client secret. (See https://digitaltrust.gcloudfactory.com for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL
envVars.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in, and required when MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true. Leave empty for stdio (local) use.

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_SCOPE
envVars.description: Optional OAuth2 scope for the service-account token request.

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_TOKEN_URL
envVars.description: Token endpoint URL for the OAuth2 client_credentials flow.

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode

name: io.github.g-digital-by-Garrigues/gocertius
description: MCP server for GoCertius: certified evidence, dossiers, notifications and chats via AI agents.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_FILE_URL
envVars.description: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only). Private/internal addresses are rejected regardless (resolution-time check; see the documented DNS TOCTOU limitation in the hosted-deployment runbook).

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER
envVars.description: Escape hatch for MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true WITHOUT inbound-token introspection: set to "true" ONLY when an upstream gateway already verifies Bearer tokens. The server logs a prominent warning and forwards tokens upstream unverified.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Empty = Host validation disabled (default). When set, requests with a Host outside the list are rejected.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense). Empty = reject any request carrying an Origin header; non-browser clients (CLI/SDK) send no Origin and are always allowed. Use '*' to allow all.

envVars.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Upstream API root. Required: your user key is exchanged for a session token against this host, and the server will not start without it.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_USER_KEY
envVars.description: Long-lived GoCertius user key, exchanged automatically for a short-lived session token. Use it for headless or automated access instead of an account password. (See https://www.gocertius.io for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC
envVars.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless (1) MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set AND (2) inbound Bearer introspection is configured (MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL + MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER=true is set explicitly (fail-closed).

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Client ID this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to GoCertius.

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Client secret this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to GoCertius. (See https://www.gocertius.io for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL
envVars.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in, and required when MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true. Leave empty for stdio (local) use.

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode

envVars.name: PG_USER
envVars.description: Postgres user.

envVars.name: PG_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Postgres password.

envVars.name: ORACLE_USER
envVars.description: Oracle user. Required when WAREHOUSE_TYPE=oracle.

envVars.description: Oracle Easy Connect (e.g. host:1521/SERVICE), TNS descriptor, or alias.

envVars.description: Snowflake username.

envVars.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Path to PKCS8 private key (.p8). Snowflake auth is key-pair only; password auth is not supported.

name: io.github.mcpsmiths/tracehub-mcp
description: Query OTel traces across Jaeger, Tempo, Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, X-Ray, New Relic, Honeycomb.

envVars.name: BACKEND_TYPE
envVars.description: Which observability backend to query.

envVars.name: BACKEND_URL
envVars.description: Backend API endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:16686 for Jaeger, https://api.datadoghq.com for Datadog, https://api.newrelic.com/graphql for New Relic, or https://api.honeycomb.io for Honeycomb. For the X-Ray backend this is decorative only (e.g. https://xray.us-east-1.amazonaws.com) - never dereferenced for a live request.

envVars.name: BACKEND_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key or auth token. Required for Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, New Relic, and Honeycomb; not used by Jaeger, Tempo, or X-Ray. For New Relic this must be a User API key, not an Ingest or License key; for Honeycomb this must be a Configuration Key, not an Ingest or Management key.

envVars.name: BACKEND_AWS_REGION
envVars.description: AWS region, e.g. us-east-1. Required for the X-Ray backend only - X-Ray authenticates via boto3's standard AWS credential chain, not BACKEND_API_KEY.

envVars.name: BACKEND_NEWRELIC_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: New Relic account ID, required for the New Relic backend only - NerdGraph queries are user-scoped, not account-scoped, so this identifies which account's data to read.

envVars.name: BACKEND_HONEYCOMB_DATASET
envVars.description: Honeycomb dataset slug, required for the Honeycomb backend only - the Query Data API is dataset-scoped.

envVars.name: BACKEND_APP_KEY
envVars.description: Datadog Application key, required in addition to BACKEND_API_KEY for the Datadog backend only.

envVars.name: BACKEND_TEMPO_INSTANCE_ID
envVars.description: Grafana Cloud stack/instance ID, used with BACKEND_API_KEY for Basic Auth (Tempo backend only, required for Grafana Cloud-hosted Tempo, not needed for self-hosted Tempo).

envVars.name: BACKEND_SENTRY_ORG
envVars.description: Sentry organization slug, required for the Sentry backend only.

envVars.name: BACKEND_SENTRY_PROJECT
envVars.description: Sentry project slug, optional for the Sentry backend - narrows queries to one project.

envVars.name: BACKEND_ENVIRONMENTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated environments for the Traceloop backend only.

envVars.name: BACKEND_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Request timeout in seconds.

envVars.name: BACKEND_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
envVars.description: Ceiling on the decoded size of any single backend response, in bytes (1 to 1073741824). An oversized body is refused before it is buffered or parsed.

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging level.

envVars.name: MAX_TRACES_PER_QUERY
envVars.description: Maximum traces validated per query (1-1000).

envVars.name: SLOW_REQUEST_THRESHOLD_MS
envVars.description: Logs a WARNING for any backend request slower than this, independent of LOG_LEVEL. Unset disables slow-request logging.

envVars.name: QUERY_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
envVars.description: Cache backend query results for this many seconds with in-flight request coalescing; finite, > 0 and at most 86400 (one day). Unset disables the cache.

envVars.name: QUERY_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES
envVars.description: Upper bound on the number of cached query results held at once (1-100000); the least-recently-used entry is evicted first.

envVars.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Enables opt-in OTel self-instrumentation of tool calls when set. Unset means zero overhead - no TracerProvider is configured and no middleware is registered.

envVars.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
envVars.description: Service name reported in self-instrumentation spans, only used when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set.

envVars.name: MCP_INCLUDE_ARGS_IN_SPANS
envVars.description: Include tool call arguments/results as OTel span attributes when self-instrumentation is enabled. Off by default since they may contain sensitive data.

description: Q402 - gasless payments, yield, escrow, bridge & NAV triggers on 12 EVM chains. Sandbox-default.

envVars.name: Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY
envVars.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Free Trial API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/event - BNB Chain (permanent) + Base (permanent) + Mantle limited-time (2026-08-21~08-28 UTC+9), 500 sponsored TXs, gas covered by Q402. Avalanche trial has ended. BNB and Base payments auto-route to this key when set (same rule for q402_pay and q402_batch_pay up to 5 recipients).

envVars.name: Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY
envVars.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Paid Multichain API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/payment - full 12-chain support with per-chain Gas Tank. Auto-routed for non-BNB payments and whenever keyScope='multichain' is chosen.

envVars.name: Q402_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Mode A - real EOA signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) of YOUR MetaMask wallet, used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. After your first payment that wallet shows as 'Smart account' in MetaMask (EIP-7702 delegation, reversible via q402_clear_delegation). Use a fresh wallet, not your main one. Skip this and pick Mode B (Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY) or Mode C (server-managed Agent Wallet) if you'd rather keep your MetaMask untouched. Recommended path: run q402_doctor after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads.

envVars.name: Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Mode B - local Agent Wallet signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) exported from your Agent Wallet at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard -> Agent tab -> Export. Signs LOCALLY just like Mode A, but the signer is your dedicated Agent Wallet - your MetaMask EOA is never touched. Pick this for AI-agent automation when you want a dedicated purse with per-tx + daily caps you set on the dashboard.

envVars.name: Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS
envVars.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move - every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Default 1 since v0.5.11: safe because mode only flips to live when a live API key (q402_live_*) is set AND one of (a) a valid 32-byte private key for local signing modes, OR (b) walletMode="agentic-server" with Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY for the server-managed Agent Wallet path. Without either combination, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.

envVars.name: Q402_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_CALL
envVars.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap for USDC/USDT/RLUSD. Any such q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing. Q (QuackAI) is exempt by design (your own token; recipient allowlist + confirmation still apply). Lower this for a tighter agent blast-radius; raise for treasury-grade transfers.

envVars.name: Q402_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.

envVars.name: Q402_RELAY_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api. Set explicitly when running against a self-hosted Q402 deployment or a non-canonical environment.

envVars.name: Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS
envVars.description: Server-managed Agent Wallet picker (walletMode='agentic-server' only). Lowercased agent wallet address (the hex 0x... shown on the Agent tab of your dashboard) selecting which of your Agent Wallets to spend from when you hold more than one (max 10 per owner). Omit to use the default wallet. Ignored for the local-signing modes that carry their own private key.

envVars.name: Q402_API_KEY
envVars.description: DEPRECATED legacy single-key env from pre-v0.5.0 installs. The server still reads it as a silent fallback so existing setups keep working, but new users should pick a scoped variant instead. Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY (Free Trial, BNB Chain + Base) and Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY (full 12-chain surface) are designed to coexist - BNB and Base payments auto-route to the trial key, other chains use multichain. Only set Q402_API_KEY if you are migrating an existing pre-v0.5.0 install; do NOT set it alongside the scoped variants on a fresh install.

envVars.name: Q402_WALLET_ID
envVars.description: DEPRECATED soft-migration alias for Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS (one release of overlap from v0.6.0). The server still accepts it but logs a deprecation notice. New installs should set Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS directly.

envVars.name: Q402_BUILDER_CODE
envVars.description: Optional Base Builder Code for onchain attribution (ERC-8021 / Base Builder Codes). When set, every q402_x402_fetch payment includes your code as the client/intermediary in the x402 payment extension so payments are attributed onchain. Format: 1-32 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. Leave unset to disable attribution.

envVars.description: Tool names the agent may never call. A value set here REPLACES the default list, which is post_status, remove_group_participants, set_webhook, set_event_channel, set_proxy, set_chatwoot_config.

envVars.description: Tools that cannot be undone (logout_instance, delete_message_for_everyone, leave_group, delete_template, delete_chatbot, delete_openai_credential) run only when this is `yes` (also `true` or `1`). Default: no.

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_DEFAULT_DELAY_MS

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_MAX_WRITES_PER_MINUTE

envVars.name: EVOLUTION_MCP_FILE_ROOTS
envVars.description: Folders send_local_files may read: absolute paths of existing directories separated by the operating system's path separator (':' on macOS and Linux, ';' on Windows). Default: Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Movies and Music in the home folder (those that exist) plus the download folder.

envVars.name: DBT_PROJECT_DIR
envVars.description: Path to dbt project root (where dbt_project.yml lives).

envVars.name: DBT_TARGET_DIR
envVars.description: dbt target dir for manifest.json/run_results.json (default: $DBT_PROJECT_DIR/target).

envVars.name: DBT_RUN_HISTORY_DIR
envVars.description: Optional dir for archived run_results.json history (glob-scanned).

envVars.name: DQ_BACKEND
envVars.description: DQ result table backend: 'bigquery' (default) or 'postgres'.

envVars.name: DQ_RESULTS_TABLE
envVars.description: Fully qualified DQ checks table, e.g. 'project.data_ops.quality_checks'.

envVars.name: DQ_SCORE_TABLE
envVars.description: Fully qualified DQ score-daily table, e.g. 'project.data_ops.quality_score_daily'.

envVars.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
envVars.description: Service account key path for BigQuery (ADC fallback supported).

envVars.name: BQ_PROJECT_ID
envVars.description: Explicit BigQuery project ID for DQ queries.

envVars.name: PG_CONNECTION_STRING
envVars.description: Postgres connection string when DQ_BACKEND=postgres.

envVars.name: DBT_ALLOW_WRITE
envVars.description: Reserved for future write tools. Default read-only.

envVars.name: DQ_SCHEMA
envVars.description: DQ result-table schema preset: 'generic' (default) or 'us-all'. Use DQ_COL_* env vars to override individual columns on top of the preset.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_RUN_AT
envVars.description: Override for the timestamp/date column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on DQ_SCHEMA preset.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_CHECK_TYPE
envVars.description: Override for the check-type column on the DQ checks table. Default 'check_type'.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_STATUS
envVars.description: Override for the status column on the DQ checks table. Default 'status'.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_DATASET
envVars.description: Override for the dataset/source column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_TABLE_NAME
envVars.description: Override for the table/target-name column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_SEVERITY
envVars.description: Override for the severity/dimension column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_FAILURE_COUNT
envVars.description: Override for the numeric failure-count column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_MESSAGE
envVars.description: Override for the message column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_CHECK_NAME
envVars.description: Override for the check_name column on the DQ checks table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' to synthesize check_name from check_type and table_name.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_SCORE_DATE
envVars.description: Override for the date column on the DQ score-daily table. Default depends on preset.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_SCOPE
envVars.description: Override for the scope column on the DQ score-daily table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' if the table has no per-scope rollup.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_TIER
envVars.description: Override for the tier column on the DQ score-daily table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' if the table has no tier dimension.

envVars.name: DQ_TIER1_TARGET_PCT
envVars.description: When no tier column is configured (us-all preset or DQ_COL_TIER=none), the overall_score threshold dq-tier-status compares against (default 99.5). Superseded by DBT_SLA_CONFIG_PATH tier_sla.1 if both are set.

envVars.name: DBT_SLA_CONFIG_PATH
envVars.description: Optional path to a YAML file that defines tier_sla (per-tier overall_score targets) and dbt_sla (test/freshness pass rates). When set, dq-tier-status and dq-tier-by-source read tier targets from this file, and dbt-sla-status compares run_results / sources pass rates against dbt_sla.test_pass_pct / freshness_pass_pct. Mtime cached.

envVars.name: DBT_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated category allowlist (dbt,quality,meta).

envVars.name: DBT_DISABLE
envVars.description: Comma-separated category disablelist.

envVars.description: Namespace the ephemeral pods are created in. Needs a Role/RoleBinding for jobs and pods.

envVars.description: MCP transport: stdio | http | sse. Must be 'stdio' for direct docker/stdio use.

envVars.description: Default wall-clock timeout per job, seconds.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Maximum wall-clock timeout a caller may request, seconds.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
envVars.description: Cap on combined stdout/stderr before truncation.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES
envVars.description: Cap on the total size of returned artifacts.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_CONCURRENT
envVars.description: Maximum ephemeral pods running at the same time.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_DEFAULT_CPU
envVars.description: Pod CPU request; limits come from the caller or the namespace LimitRange.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_DEFAULT_MEMORY
envVars.description: Pod memory request; limits come from the caller or the namespace LimitRange.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_SIDECAR_IMAGE
envVars.description: Helper image used to inject input files and collect artifacts.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_CLONE_IMAGE
envVars.description: Image carrying git for the clone init container. Empty disables the clone field.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_CLONE_SECRET
envVars.description: Secret with git tokens, mounted only on the cloner. Empty disables the clone field.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_CACHE_PVC
envVars.description: Existing PVC mounted into every job pod as a shared cache. Empty = no cache.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_CACHE_MOUNT_PATH
envVars.description: Where the cache PVC is mounted, e.g. /go/pkg/mod. Empty = no cache.

envVars.name: MCP_K8S_JOB_EXTRA_ENV
envVars.description: JSON object of env vars added to every job pod; caller keys win on collision.

envVars.description: Path to the kubeconfig inside the container. Must match the mount destination. There is no fallback to ~/.kube/config and no in-cluster config: a missing, unreadable or malformed file is a startup failure rather than a silent downgrade to an ambient credential.

envVars.description: Comma-separated namespaces the server may read, e.g. staging,production. Wildcards (* and all) are rejected at startup, and kube-system and kube-public are stripped even if listed. This is defense-in-depth, not the security boundary — the boundary is the ServiceAccount's RBAC bindings.

envVars.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR. All logging goes to stderr; stdout carries the JSON-RPC stream exclusively.

envVars.description: Kubernetes API request timeout. Must be a positive integer.

envVars.name: MAX_LOG_LINES
envVars.description: Maximum log lines any single get_pod_logs call may return. Must be a positive integer; clamped to a hard ceiling of 1000 with a warning.
